session_1.speaker: Sarah
session_1.text: Hey Jess! Good to see you! How have you been?

session_1.speaker: Jessica
session_1.text: Hey Sarah! Good to see you! I'm swamped with the kids & work. What's up with you? Anything new?

session_1.speaker: Sarah
session_1.text: I went to a LGBTQ support group yesterday and it was so powerful.

session_1.speaker: Jessica
session_1.text: Wow, that's cool, Sarah! What happened that was so awesome? Did you hear any inspiring stories?

session_1.speaker: Sarah
session_1.text: The transgender stories were so inspiring! I was so happy and thankful for all the support.

session_1.speaker: Jessica
session_1.text: Wow, love that painting! So cool you found such a helpful group. What's it done for you?

session_1.speaker: Sarah
session_1.text: The support group has made me feel accepted and given me courage to embrace myself.

session_1.speaker: Jessica
session_1.text: That's really cool. You've got guts. What now?

session_1.speaker: Sarah
session_1.text: Gonna continue my edu and check out career options, which is pretty exciting!

session_1.speaker: Jessica
session_1.text: Wow, Sarah! What kinda jobs are you thinkin' of? Anything that stands out?

session_1.speaker: Sarah
session_1.text: I'm keen on counseling or working in mental health - I'd love to support those with similar issues.

session_1.speaker: Jessica
session_1.text: You'd be a great counselor! Your empathy and understanding will really help the people you work with. By the way, take a look at this.

session_1.speaker: Sarah
session_1.text: Thanks, Jessica! That's really sweet. Is this your own painting?

session_1.speaker: Jessica
session_1.text: Yeah, I painted that lake sunrise last year! It's special to me.

session_1.speaker: Sarah
session_1.text: Wow, Jessica! The colors really blend nicely. Painting looks like a great outlet for expressing yourself.

session_1.speaker: Jessica
session_1.text: Thanks, Sarah! Painting's a fun way to express my feelings and get creative. It's a great way to relax after a long day.

session_1.speaker: Sarah
session_1.text: Totally agree, Jess. Relaxing and expressing ourselves is key. Well, I'm off to go do some research.

session_1.speaker: Jessica
session_1.text: Yep, Sarah. Taking care of ourselves is vital. I'm off to go swimming with the kids. Talk to you soon!

session_2.speaker: Jessica
session_2.text: Hey Sarah, since we last chatted, I've had a lot of things happening to me. I ran a charity race for mental health last Saturday – it was really rewarding. Really made me think about taking care of our minds.

session_2.speaker: Sarah
session_2.text: That charity race sounds great, Jess! Making a difference & raising awareness for mental health is super rewarding - I'm really proud of you for taking part!

session_2.speaker: Jessica
session_2.text: Thanks, Sarah! The event was really thought-provoking. I'm starting to realize that self-care is really important. It's a journey for me, but when I look after myself, I'm able to better look after my family.

session_2.speaker: Sarah
session_2.text: I totally agree, Jessica. Taking care of ourselves is so important - even if it's not always easy. Great that you're prioritizing self-care.

session_2.speaker: Jessica
session_2.text: Yeah, it's tough. So I'm carving out some me-time each day - running, reading, or playing my violin - which refreshes me and helps me stay present for my fam!

session_2.speaker: Sarah
session_2.text: That's great, Jess! Taking time for yourself is so important. You're doing an awesome job looking after yourself and your family!

session_2.speaker: Jessica
session_2.text: Thanks, Sarah. It's still a work in progress, but I'm doing my best. My kids are so excited about summer break! We're thinking about going camping next month. Any fun plans for the summer?

session_2.speaker: Sarah
session_2.text: Researching adoption agencies — it's been a dream to have a family and give a loving home to kids who need it.

session_2.speaker: Jessica
session_2.text: Wow, Sarah! That's awesome! Taking in kids in need - you're so kind. Your future family is gonna be so lucky to have you!

session_2.speaker: Sarah
session_2.text: Thanks, Jess! My goal is to give kids a loving home. I'm truly grateful for all the support I've got from friends and mentors. Now the hard work starts to turn my dream into a reality. And here's one of the adoption agencies I'm looking into. It's a lot to take in, but I'm feeling hopeful and optimistic.

session_2.speaker: Jessica
session_2.text: Wow, that agency looks great! What made you pick it?

session_2.speaker: Sarah
session_2.text: I chose them 'cause they help LGBTQ+ folks with adoption. Their inclusivity and support really spoke to me.

session_2.speaker: Jessica
session_2.text: That's great, Sarah! Loving the inclusivity and support. Anything you're excited for in the adoption process?

session_2.speaker: Sarah
session_2.text: I'm thrilled to make a family for kids who need one. It'll be tough as a single parent, but I'm up for the challenge!

session_2.speaker: Jessica
session_2.text: You're doing something amazing! Creating a family for those kids is so lovely. You'll be an awesome mom! Good luck!

session_2.speaker: Sarah
session_2.text: Thanks, Jessica! Your kind words really mean a lot. I'll do my best to make sure these kids have a safe and loving home.

session_2.speaker: Jessica
session_2.text: No doubts, Sarah. You have such a caring heart - they'll get all the love and stability they need! Excited for this new chapter!

session_3.speaker: Sarah
session_3.text: Hey Jessica! How's it going? I wanted to tell you about my school event last week. It was awesome! I talked about my transgender journey and encouraged students to get involved in the LGBTQ community. It was great to see their reactions. It made me reflect on how far I've come since I started transitioning three years ago.

session_3.speaker: Jessica
session_3.text: Hey Sarah! Great to hear from you. Sounds like your event was amazing! I'm so proud of you for spreading awareness and getting others involved in the LGBTQ community. You've come a long way since your transition - keep on inspiring people with your strength and courage!

session_3.speaker: Sarah
session_3.text: Thanks, Jess! Your backing really means a lot. I felt super powerful giving my talk. I shared my own journey, the struggles I had and how much I've developed since coming out. It was wonderful to see how the audience related to what I said and how it inspired them to be better allies. Conversations about gender identity and inclusion are so necessary and I'm thankful for being able to give a voice to the trans community.

session_3.speaker: Jessica
session_3.text: Wow, Sarah, you're doing an awesome job of inspiring others with your journey. It's great to be part of it and see how you're positively affecting so many. Talking about inclusivity and acceptance is crucial, and you're so brave to speak up for the trans community. Keep up the great work!

session_3.speaker: Sarah
session_3.text: Thanks Jess! Your kind words mean a lot. Sharing our experiences isn't always easy, but I feel it's important to help promote understanding and acceptance. I've been blessed with loads of love and support throughout this journey, and I want to pass it on to others. By sharing our stories, we can build a strong, supportive community of hope.

session_3.speaker: Jessica
session_3.text: Yeah, Sarah! It takes courage to talk about our own stories. But it's in these vulnerable moments that we bond and understand each other. We all have our different paths, but if we share them, we show people that they're not alone. Our stories can be so inspiring and encouraging to others who are facing the same challenges. Thank you for using your voice to create love, acceptance, and hope. You're doing amazing!

session_3.speaker: Sarah
session_3.text: Your words mean a lot to me. I'm grateful for the chance to share my story and give others hope. We all have unique paths, and by working together we can build a more inclusive and understanding world. I'm going to keep using my voice to make a change and lift others up. And you're part of that!

session_3.speaker: Jessica
session_3.text: Thanks, Sarah, for letting me join your journey. I'm so proud to be part of the difference you're making. Let's keep motivating and helping each other out as we journey through life. We can make a real impact together!

session_3.speaker: Sarah
session_3.text: Yeah Jess, let's spread love and understanding! Thanks for the support and encouragement. We can tackle life's challenges together! We got this!

session_3.speaker: Jessica
session_3.text: Yes, Sarah! We can do it. Your courage is inspiring. I want to be couragous for my family- they motivate me and give me love. What motivates you?

session_3.speaker: Sarah
session_3.text: Thanks, Jess! My friends, family and mentors are my rocks – they motivate me and give me the strength to push on. Here's a pic from when we met up last week!

session_3.speaker: Jessica
session_3.text: Wow, that photo is great! How long have you had such a great support system?

session_3.speaker: Sarah
session_3.text: Yeah, I'm really lucky to have them. They've been there through everything, I've known these friends for 4 years, since I moved from my home country. Their love and help have been so important especially after that tough breakup. I'm super thankful. Who supports you, Jess?

session_3.speaker: Jessica
session_3.text: I'm lucky to have my husband and kids; they keep me motivated.

session_3.speaker: Sarah
session_3.text: Wow, what an amazing family pic! How long have you been married?

session_3.speaker: Jessica
session_3.text: 5 years already! Time flies- feels like just yesterday I put this dress on! Thanks, Sarah!

session_3.speaker: Sarah
session_3.text: Congrats, Jessica! You both looked so great on your wedding day! Wishing you many happy years together!

session_3.speaker: Jessica
session_3.text: Thanks, Sarah! Appreciate your kind words. Looking forward to more happy years. Our family and moments make it all worth it.

session_3.speaker: Sarah
session_3.text: Looks like you had a great day! How was it? You all look so happy!

session_3.speaker: Jessica
session_3.text: It so fun! We played games, ate good food, and just hung out together. Family moments make life awesome.

session_3.speaker: Sarah
session_3.text: Sounds great, Jess! Glad you had a great time. Cherish the moments - they're the best!

session_3.speaker: Jessica
session_3.text: Absolutely, Sarah! I cherish time with family. It's when I really feel alive and happy.

session_3.speaker: Sarah
session_3.text: I 100% agree, Jess. Hanging with loved ones is amazing and brings so much happiness. Those moments really make me thankful. Family is everything.

session_4.speaker: Sarah
session_4.text: Hey Jessica! Long time no talk! A lot's been going on in my life! Take a look at this.

session_4.speaker: Jessica
session_4.text: Hey, Sarah! Nice to hear from you! Love the necklace, any special meaning to it?

session_4.speaker: Sarah
session_4.text: Thanks, Jessica! This necklace is super special to me - a gift from my grandma in my home country, Norway. She gave it to me when I was young, and it stands for love, faith and strength. It's like a reminder of my roots and all the love and support I get from my family.

session_4.speaker: Jessica
session_4.text: That's gorgeous, Sarah! It's awesome what items can mean so much to us, right? Got any other objects that you treasure, like that necklace?

session_4.speaker: Sarah
session_4.text: Yep, Jessica! I've got some other stuff with sentimental value, like my hand-painted bowl. A friend made it for my 18th birthday ten years ago. The pattern and colors are awesome-- it reminds me of art and self-expression.

session_4.speaker: Jessica
session_4.text: That sounds great, Sarah! It's awesome having stuff around that make us think of good connections and times. Actually, I just took my fam camping in the mountains last week - it was a really nice time together!

session_4.speaker: Sarah
session_4.text: Sounds great, Jess. Glad you made some new family mems. How was it? Anything fun?

session_4.speaker: Jessica
session_4.text: It was an awesome time, Sarah! We explored nature, roasted marshmallows around the campfire and even went on a hike. The view from the top was amazing! The 2 younger kids love nature. It was so special having these moments together as a family - I'll never forget it!

session_4.speaker: Sarah
session_4.text: That's awesome, Jessica! Family moments like that are so special. Glad y'all had such a great time.

session_4.speaker: Jessica
session_4.text: Thanks, Sarah! Family time matters to me. What's up with you lately?

session_4.speaker: Sarah
session_4.text: Lately, I've been looking into counseling and mental health as a career. I want to help people who have gone through the same things as me.

session_4.speaker: Jessica
session_4.text: Sounds great! What kind of counseling and mental health services do you want to persue?

session_4.speaker: Sarah
session_4.text: I'm still figuring out the details, but I'm thinking of working with trans people, helping them accept themselves and supporting their mental health. Last Friday, I went to an LGBTQ+ counseling workshop and it was really enlightening. They talked about different therapeutic methods and how to best work with trans people. Seeing how passionate these pros were about making a safe space for people like me was amazing.

session_4.speaker: Jessica
session_4.text: Woah, Sarah, it sounds like you're doing some impressive work. It's inspiring to see your dedication to helping others. What motivated you to pursue counseling?

session_4.speaker: Sarah
session_4.text: Thanks, Jessica. It really mattered. My own journey and the support I got made a huge difference. Now I want to help people go through it too. I saw how counseling and support groups improved my life, so I started caring more about mental health and understanding myself. Now I'm passionate about creating a safe, inviting place for people to grow.

session_4.speaker: Jessica
session_4.text: Wow, Sarah! You've gained so much from your own experience. Your passion and hard work to help others is awesome. Keep it up, you're making a big impact!

session_4.speaker: Sarah
session_4.text: Thanks, Jessica! Your kind words mean a lot.

session_4.speaker: Jessica
session_4.text: Congrats Sarah! Good on you for going after what you really care about.

session_5.speaker: Sarah
session_5.text: Since we last spoke, some big things have happened. Last week I went to an LGBTQ+ pride parade. Everyone was so happy and it made me feel like I belonged. It showed me how much our community has grown, it was amazing!

session_5.speaker: Jessica
session_5.text: Wow, Sarah, sounds like the parade was an awesome experience! It's great to see the love and support for the LGBTQ+ community. Congrats! Has this experience influenced your goals at all?

session_5.speaker: Sarah
session_5.text: Thanks, Jess! It really motivated me for sure. Talking to the community made me want to use my story to help others too - I'm still thinking that counseling and mental health is the way to go. I'm super excited to give back.

session_5.speaker: Jessica
session_5.text: Wow, Sarah! That's great! I just signed up for a pottery class yesterday. It's like therapy for me, letting me express myself and get creative. Have you found any activities that make you feel the same way?

session_5.speaker: Sarah
session_5.text: Wow, Jessica! I'm getting creative too, just learning the piano. What made you try pottery?

session_5.speaker: Jessica
session_5.text: I'm a big fan of pottery - the creativity and skill is awesome. Plus, making it is so calming. Look at this!

session_5.speaker: Sarah
session_5.text: That bowl is gorgeous! The black and white design looks so fancy. Did you make it?

session_5.speaker: Jessica
session_5.text: Thanks, Sarah! Yeah, I made this bowl in my class. It took some work, but I'm pretty proud of it.

session_5.speaker: Sarah
session_5.text: Nice job! You really put in the work and it definitely shows. Your creativity looks great!

session_5.speaker: Jessica
session_5.text: Thanks, Sarah! Your kind words mean a lot. Pottery is a huge part of my life, not just a hobby - it helps me express my emotions. Clay is incredible, it brings me so much joy!

session_5.speaker: Sarah
session_5.text: Wow, Jess, I'm so stoked for you that art is helping you express yourself and bring you joy! Keep it up!

session_5.speaker: Jessica
session_5.text: Thanks, Sarah! I'm excited to see where pottery takes me. Anything coming up you're looking forward to?

session_5.speaker: Sarah
session_5.text: Thanks Jess! I'm going to a transgender conference this month. I'm so excited to meet other people in the community and learn more about advocacy. It's gonna be great!

session_5.speaker: Jessica
session_5.text: Sounds awesome, Sarah! Have a great time and learn a lot. Have fun!

session_5.speaker: Sarah
session_5.text: Cool, thanks Jess! Can't wait. I'll keep ya posted. Bye!

session_5.speaker: Jessica
session_5.text: Bye, Sarah! Can't wait to hear about it. Have fun and stay safe!

session_6.speaker: Sarah
session_6.text: Hey Jess! Long time no talk. Lots has been going on since then!

session_6.speaker: Jessica
session_6.text: Hey Sarah! Missed you. Anything new? Spill the beans!

session_6.speaker: Sarah
session_6.text: Since our last chat, I've been looking into counseling or mental health work more. I'm passionate about helping people and making a positive impact. It's tough, but really rewarding too. Anything new happening with you?

session_6.speaker: Jessica
session_6.text: That's awesome, Sarah! Congrats on following your dreams. Yesterday I took the kids to the museum - it was so cool spending time with them and seeing their eyes light up!

session_6.speaker: Sarah
session_6.text: Jessica, that's a great pic! That must have been awesome. What were they so stoked about?

session_6.speaker: Jessica
session_6.text: They were stoked for the dinosaur exhibit! They love learning about animals and the bones were so cool. It reminds me why I love being a mom.

session_6.speaker: Sarah
session_6.text: Being a mom is awesome. I'm creating a library for when I have kids. I'm really looking forward to reading to them and opening up their minds.

session_6.speaker: Jessica
session_6.text: Sounds great! What kind of books you got in your library?

session_6.speaker: Sarah
session_6.text: I've got lots of kids' books- classics, stories from different cultures, educational books, all of that. What's a favorite book you remember from your childhood?

session_6.speaker: Jessica
session_6.text: I loved reading "Charlotte's Web" as a kid. It was so cool seeing how friendship and compassion can make a difference.

session_6.speaker: Sarah
session_6.text: Wow, that's great! It sure shows how important friendship and compassion are. It's made me appreciate how lucky I am to have my friends and family helping with my transition. They make all the difference. We even had a picnic last week!

session_6.speaker: Jessica
session_6.text: That's a gorgeous photo, Sarah! Wow, the love around you is awesome. How have your friends and fam been helping you out with your transition?

session_6.speaker: Sarah
session_6.text: Thanks, Jessica! This support network has been amazing. They've been there for me every step of the way giving me love, guidance, and acceptance. I couldn't have done it without them.

session_6.speaker: Jessica
session_6.text: Wow, Sarah! It's great you have people to support you, that's really awesome!

session_6.speaker: Sarah
session_6.text: I'm so lucky to have such a great support system around me. Their love and encouragement has really helped me accept and grow into my true self. They've been instrumental in my transition.

session_6.speaker: Jessica
session_6.text: Glad you have support, Sarah! Unconditional love is so important. Here's a pic of my family camping at the beach. We love it, it brings us closer!

session_7.speaker: Sarah
session_7.text: Hey Jess, great to chat with you again! So much has happened since we last spoke - I went to an LGBTQ conference two days ago and it was really special. I got the chance to meet and connect with people who've gone through similar journeys. It was such a welcoming environment and I felt totally accepted. I'm really thankful for this amazing community - it's shown me how important it is to fight for trans rights and spread awareness.

session_7.speaker: Jessica
session_7.text: Wow, Sarah, that sounds awesome! So glad you felt accepted and supported. Events like these are great for reminding us of how strong community can be!

session_7.speaker: Sarah
session_7.text: Yeah, it's true! Having people who back you makes such a huge difference. It's great to see how far LGBTQ rights have come, but there's still plenty of progress to be made. I wanna help make a difference.

session_7.speaker: Jessica
session_7.text: Wow, Sarah. We've come so far, but there's more to do. Your drive to help is awesome! What's your plan to pitch in?

session_7.speaker: Sarah
session_7.text: Thanks, Jess! I'm still looking into counseling and mental health jobs. It's important to me that people have someone to talk to, and I want to help make that happen.

session_7.speaker: Jessica
session_7.text: Wow, Sarah! You're so inspiring for wanting to help others with their mental health. What's pushing you to keep going forward with it?

session_7.speaker: Sarah
session_7.text: I struggled with mental health, and support I got was really helpful. It made me realize how important it is for others to have a support system. So, I started looking into counseling and mental health career options, so I could help other people on their own journeys like I was helped.

session_7.speaker: Jessica
session_7.text: Sarah, so glad you got the support! Your experience really brought you to where you need to be. You're gonna make a huge difference! This book I read last year reminds me to always pursue my dreams, just like you are doing!🌟

session_7.speaker: Sarah
session_7.text: Thanks so much, Jess! Seeing this pic just made me appreciate my love of reading even more. Books guide me, motivate me and help me discover who I am. They're a huge part of my journey, and this one's reminding me to keep going and never give up!

session_7.speaker: Jessica
session_7.text: Wow, Sarah! Books have such an awesome power! Which one has been your favorite guide?

session_7.speaker: Sarah
session_7.text: I loved "Becoming Nicole" by Amy Ellis Nutt. It's a real inspiring true story about a trans girl and her family. It made me feel connected and gave me a lot of hope for my own path. Highly recommend it for sure!

session_7.speaker: Jessica
session_7.text: That sounds awesome! What did you take away from it to use in your life?

session_7.speaker: Sarah
session_7.text: It taught me self-acceptance and how to find support. It also showed me that tough times don't last - hope and love exist. Pets bring so much joy too, though.

session_7.speaker: Jessica
session_7.text: Sarah, those lessons are great - self-acceptance and finding support are key. Plus pets are awesome for joy and comfort, can't agree more!

session_7.speaker: Sarah
session_7.text: That's so nice! What pet do you have?

session_7.speaker: Jessica
session_7.text: We've got a pup and a kitty. That's the dog, and here's our cat! They brighten up our day and always make us smile.

session_7.speaker: Sarah
session_7.text: Ah, they're adorable! What are their names? Pets sure do bring so much joy to us!

session_7.speaker: Jessica
session_7.text: Luna and Oliver! They are so sweet and playful - they really liven up the house! Just got some new shoes, too!

session_7.speaker: Sarah
session_7.text: Love that purple color! For walking or running?

session_7.speaker: Jessica
session_7.text: Thanks, Sarah! These are for running. Been running longer since our last chat - a great way to destress and clear my mind.

session_7.speaker: Sarah
session_7.text: Wow! What got you into running?

session_7.speaker: Jessica
session_7.text: I've been running farther to de-stress, which has been great for my headspace.

session_7.speaker: Sarah
session_7.text: Cool, Jessica! Running can really boost your mood. Keep it up!

session_7.speaker: Jessica
session_7.text: Thanks, Sarah! This has been great for my mental health. I'm gonna keep it up.

session_7.speaker: Sarah
session_7.text: Awesome, Jessica! Mental health's a priority, so make sure you take care of yourself.

session_7.speaker: Jessica
session_7.text: Sarah, thanks! Mental health is important to me, and it's made such an improvement!

session_7.speaker: Sarah
session_7.text: Glad it helped ya, Jessica!

session_8.speaker: Sarah
session_8.text: Hey Jess, what's up? Been a busy week since we talked.

session_8.speaker: Jessica
session_8.text: Hey Sarah, it's been super busy here. So much since we talked! Last Fri I finally took my kids to a pottery workshop. We all made our own pots, it was fun and therapeutic!

session_8.speaker: Sarah
session_8.text: Wow, Jess! Sounds like you and the kids had a blast. How'd they like it?

session_8.speaker: Jessica
session_8.text: The kids loved it! They were so excited to get their hands dirty and make something with clay. It was special to watch their creativity and imagination come to life, they made this!

session_8.speaker: Sarah
session_8.text: Aww, that's so sweet! That cup is so cute. It's awesome to see how kids show their personalities through art. What other creative projects do you do with them, besides pottery?

session_8.speaker: Jessica
session_8.text: We love painting together lately, especially nature-inspired ones. Here's our latest work from last weekend.

session_8.speaker: Sarah
session_8.text: Wow Jess, that painting's amazing! The colors are so bold and it really highlights the beauty of nature. Y'all work on it together?

session_8.speaker: Jessica
session_8.text: Thanks, Sarah! We both helped with the painting - it was great bonding over it and chatting about nature. We found these lovely flowers. Appreciating the small things in life, too.

session_8.speaker: Sarah
session_8.text: That photo is stunning! So glad you bonded over our love of nature. Last Friday I went to a council meeting for adoption. It was inspiring and emotional - so many people wanted to create loving homes for children in need. It made me even more determined to adopt.

session_8.speaker: Jessica
session_8.text: Wow, Sarah, way to go! Your future fam will get a kick out of having you. What do you think of these?

session_8.speaker: Sarah
session_8.text: Thanks Jessica - love the blue vase in the pic! Blue's my fave, it makes me feel relaxed. Sunflowers mean warmth and happiness, right? While roses stand for love and beauty? That's neat. What do flowers mean to you?

session_8.speaker: Jessica
session_8.text: Flowers bring joy. They represent growth, beauty and reminding us to appreciate the small moments. They were an important part of my wedding decor and always remind me of that day.

session_8.speaker: Sarah
session_8.text: It must have been special at your wedding. I wish I had known you back then!

session_8.speaker: Jessica
session_8.text: It was amazing, Sarah. The day was full of love and joy. Everyone we love was there to celebrate us - it was really special.

session_8.speaker: Sarah
session_8.text: Wow, what a great day! Glad everyone could make it. What was your favorite part?

session_8.speaker: Jessica
session_8.text: Marrying my partner and promising to be together forever was the best part.

session_8.speaker: Sarah
session_8.text: Wow, nice pic! You both looked amazing. One special memory for me was this pride parade I went to a few weeks ago.

session_8.speaker: Jessica
session_8.text: Wow, looks awesome! Did you join in?

session_8.speaker: Sarah
session_8.text: Yes, I did. It was amazing! I felt so accepted and happy, just being around people who accepted and celebrated me. It's definitely a top memory.

session_8.speaker: Jessica
session_8.text: Wow, what an experience! How did it make you feel?

session_8.speaker: Sarah
session_8.text: I felt so proud and grateful - the vibes were amazing and it was comforting to know I'm not alone and have a great community around me.

session_8.speaker: Jessica
session_8.text: Wow, Sarah! That's huge! How did it feel to be around so much love and acceptance?

session_8.speaker: Sarah
session_8.text: It was awesome, Jessica! Being around people who embrace and back me up is beyond words. It really inspired me.

session_8.speaker: Jessica
session_8.text: Wow, that sounds awesome! Your friends and community really have your back. What's been the best part of it?

session_8.speaker: Sarah
session_8.text: Realizing I can be me without fear and having the courage to transition was the best part. It's so freeing to express myself authentically and have people back me up.

session_8.speaker: Jessica
session_8.text: That's awesome, Sar! You've found the courage to be yourself - that's important for our mental health and finding peace.

session_8.speaker: Sarah
session_8.text: Thanks, Jessica! Been a long road, but I'm proud of how far I've come. How're you doing finding peace?

session_8.speaker: Jessica
session_8.text: I'm getting there, Sarah. Creativity and family keep me at peace.

session_8.speaker: Sarah
session_8.text: That's awesome, Jessica! How have your family been supportive during your move?

session_8.speaker: Jessica
session_8.text: My fam's been awesome - they helped out and showed lots of love and support.

session_8.speaker: Sarah
session_8.text: Wow, Jess, family love and support is the best!

session_8.speaker: Jessica
session_8.text: Yeah, Sarah, my family's been great - their love and support really helped me through tough times. It's awesome! We even went on another camping trip in the forest.

session_8.speaker: Sarah
session_8.text: Awesome, Jess! Family support's huge. What else do you guys like doing together?

session_8.speaker: Jessica
session_8.text: We enjoy hiking in the mountains and exploring forests. It's a cool way to connect with nature and each other.

session_8.speaker: Sarah
session_8.text: Wow, Jess, that sounds awesome! Exploring nature and family time is so special.

session_8.speaker: Jessica
session_8.text: Yeah, Sarah, they're some of my fave memories. It brings us together and brings us happiness. Glad you're here to share in it.

session_8.speaker: Sarah
session_8.text: Thanks, Jessica! Really glad to have you as a friend to share my journey. You're awesome!

session_8.speaker: Jessica
session_8.text: Thanks, Sarah! Appreciate your friendship. It's great to have a supporter!

session_8.speaker: Sarah
session_8.text: No worries, Jess! Your friendship means so much to me. Enjoy your day!

session_9.speaker: Jessica
session_9.text: Hey Sarah, hope all's good! I had a quiet weekend after we went camping with my fam two weekends ago. It was great to unplug and hang with the kids. What've you been up to? Anything fun over the weekend?

session_9.speaker: Sarah
session_9.text: Hey Jessica! That sounds great! Last weekend I joined a mentorship program for LGBTQ youth - it's really rewarding to help the community.

session_9.speaker: Jessica
session_9.text: Wow, Sarah! It's great that you're helping out. How's it going? Got any cool experiences you can share?

session_9.speaker: Sarah
session_9.text: The mentoring is going great! I've met some amazing young folks and supported them along the way. It's inspiring to see how resilient and strong they are.

session_9.speaker: Jessica
session_9.text: Wow, Sarah, that sounds super rewarding! Young people's resilience is amazing. Care to share some stories?

session_9.speaker: Sarah
session_9.text: I mentor a transgender teen just like me. We've been working on building up confidence and finding positive strategies, and it's really been paying off! We had a great time at the LGBT pride event last month.

session_9.speaker: Jessica
session_9.text: Sarah, awesome news that you two are getting along! What was it like for you both? Care to fill me in?

session_9.speaker: Sarah
session_9.text: The pride event was awesome! It was so encouraging to be surrounded by so much love and acceptance.

session_9.speaker: Jessica
session_9.text: Wow! What's the best part you remember from it?

session_9.speaker: Sarah
session_9.text: Seeing my mentee's face light up when they saw the support was the best! Such a special moment.

session_9.speaker: Jessica
session_9.text: Wow, Sarah! They must have felt so appreciated. It's awesome to see the difference we can make in each other's lives. Any other exciting LGBTQ advocacy stuff coming up?

session_9.speaker: Sarah
session_9.text: Yay! Next month I'm having an LGBTQ art show with my paintings - can't wait!

session_9.speaker: Jessica
session_9.text: Wow, Sarah, that sounds awesome! Can't wait to see your art - got any previews?

session_9.speaker: Sarah
session_9.text: Check out my painting for the art show! Hope you like it.

session_9.speaker: Jessica
session_9.text: Wow, Sarah, that painting is awesome! Those colors are so vivid and the whole thing looks really unified. What inspired you?

session_9.speaker: Sarah
session_9.text: Thanks, Jessica! I painted this after I visited a LGBTQ center. I wanted to capture everyone's unity and strength.

session_9.speaker: Jessica
session_9.text: Wow, Sarah! It really conveys unity and strength - such a gorgeous piece! My kids and I just finished another painting like our last one.

session_10.speaker: Sarah
session_10.text: Hey Jessica! Just wanted to say hi!

session_10.speaker: Jessica
session_10.text: Hey Sarah! Good to talk to you again. What's up? Anything new since last time?

session_10.speaker: Sarah
session_10.text: Hey Jess! A lot's happened since we last chatted - I just joined a new LGBTQ activist group last Tues. I'm meeting so many cool people who are as passionate as I am about rights and community support. I'm giving my voice and making a real difference, plus it's fulfilling in so many ways. It's just great, you know?

session_10.speaker: Jessica
session_10.text: That's awesome, Sarah! Glad to hear you found a great group where you can have an impact. Bet it feels great to be able to speak your truth and stand up for what's right. Want to tell me a bit more about it?

session_10.speaker: Sarah
session_10.text: Thanks, Jessica! It's awesome to have our own platform to be ourselves and support others' rights. Our group, 'The Pride Alliance', is made of all kinds of people investing in positive changes. We have regular meetings, plan events and campaigns, to get together and support each other.

session_10.speaker: Jessica
session_10.text: Wow, Sarah, your group sounds awesome! Supporting each other and making good things happen - that's so inspiring! Have you been part of any events or campaigns lately?

session_10.speaker: Sarah
session_10.text: Last weekend our city held a pride parade! So many people marched through the streets waving flags, holding signs and celebrating love and diversity. I missed it but it was a powerful reminder that we are not alone in this fight for equality and inclusivity. Change is possible!

session_10.speaker: Jessica
session_10.text: Wow, fantastic, Sarah! Bet the atmosphere was incredible. Oh yeah, we went to the beach recently. It was awesome! The kids had such a blast.

session_10.speaker: Sarah
session_10.text: Sounds fun! What was the best part? Do you do it often with the kids?

session_10.speaker: Jessica
session_10.text: Seeing my kids' faces so happy at the beach was the best! We don't go often, usually only once or twice a year. But those times are always special to spend time together and chill.

session_10.speaker: Sarah
session_10.text: Sounds special, those beach trips! Do you have any other summer traditions you all do together? Create those memories!

session_10.speaker: Jessica
session_10.text: We always look forward to our family camping trip. We roast marshmallows, tell stories around the campfire and just enjoy each other's company. It's the highlight of our summer!

session_10.speaker: Sarah
session_10.text: Wow, Jess, that's awesome! What's your best camping memory?

session_10.speaker: Jessica
session_10.text: I'll always remember our camping trip last year when we saw the Perseid meteor shower. It was so amazing lying there and watching the sky light up with streaks of light. We all made wishes and felt so at one with the universe. That's a memory I'll never forget.

session_10.speaker: Sarah
session_10.text: Cool! What did it look like?

session_10.speaker: Jessica
session_10.text: The sky was so clear and filled with stars, and the meteor shower was amazing - it felt like we were part of something huge and awe-inspiring.

session_10.speaker: Sarah
session_10.text: Wow, Jess. That must've been breathtaking!

session_10.speaker: Jessica
session_10.text: It was one of those moments where I felt tiny and in awe of the universe. Reminds me how awesome life is - so many little moments like that.

session_10.speaker: Sarah
session_10.text: That's great, Jess! What other good memories do you have that make you feel thankful for life?

session_10.speaker: Jessica
session_10.text: I'll never forget the day my youngest took her first steps. Seeing her wobble as she took those initial steps really put into perspective how fleeting life is and how lucky I am to be able to share these moments.

session_10.speaker: Sarah
session_10.text: Aw, that's sweet, Jess! Those milestones are great reminders of how special our bonds are.

session_10.speaker: Jessica
session_10.text: Yeah, they sure are. It's special moments like these that make me appreciate life and how lucky I am to be with my family and have our love.

session_10.speaker: Sarah
session_10.text: Wow, Jessica, what a beautiful moment! Lucky you to have such an awesome family!

session_10.speaker: Jessica
session_10.text: Thanks, Sarah! I'm really lucky to have my family; they bring so much joy and love.

session_11.speaker: Jessica
session_11.text: Hey Sarah! Last night was amazing! We celebrated my daughter's birthday with a concert surrounded by music, joy and the warm summer breeze. Seeing my kids' smiles was so awesome, and I'm so thankful for our special moments together.

session_11.speaker: Sarah
session_11.text: Wow, sounds wonderful! Your love for your kids is so awesome. What concert was it? The advocacy event was a cool experience - so much love and support, amazing!

session_11.speaker: Jessica
session_11.text: Thanks, Sarah! It was Matt Patterson, he is so talented! His voice and songs were amazing. What's up with you? Anything interesting going on?

session_11.speaker: Sarah
session_11.text: Wow, Jess, glad you had a blast at the concert. A lot's happened since we talked. I went to a pride parade last Friday and it was awesome - so much energy and love everywhere. Really made me proud and reminded me how important it is to keep standing up for equality.

session_11.speaker: Jessica
session_11.text: Wow, that's awesome! How did it feel being part of that community?

session_11.speaker: Sarah
session_11.text: It was so inspiring, Jess! Check out the crowd. People of all kinds celebrating love and acceptance - it really pushed me to keep fighting for LGBTQ rights.

session_11.speaker: Jessica
session_11.text: Wow, Sarah! That sounds awesome. This pic's from last night - looks like everyone was having a blast! Reminds me it's important to cultivate a loving and accepting environment for our kids. How do you stay inclusive in your work as an artist?

session_11.speaker: Sarah
session_11.text: That pic is cool! Representing inclusivity and diversity in my art is important to me. I also use it to speak up for the LGBTQ+ community and push for acceptance. Here's a recent painting!

session_11.speaker: Jessica
session_11.text: Wow, that rocks! What's the main idea of your art?

session_11.speaker: Sarah
session_11.text: My art is about expressing my trans experience. It's my way of showing my story and helping people understand the trans community.

session_11.speaker: Jessica
session_11.text: Your art's amazing, Sarah. I love how you use it to tell your stories and teach people about trans folks. I'd love to see another painting of yours!

session_11.speaker: Sarah
session_11.text: Thanks, Jessica. Here's one- 'Embracing Identity' is all about finding comfort and love in being yourself. The woman in the painting stands for the journey of acceptance. My aim was to show warmth, love and self-acceptance.

session_11.speaker: Jessica
session_11.text: Wow, Sarah, that's gorgeous! I love the self-acceptance and love theme. How does art help you with your self-discovery and acceptance journey?

session_11.speaker: Sarah
session_11.text: Art's allowed me to explore my transition and my changing body. It's been a great way to work through stuff I'm going through. I love that it teaches me to accept the beauty of imperfections.

session_11.speaker: Jessica
session_11.text: Wow, Sarah, that's so cool! Art can be so healing and a way to really connect with who you are. It's awesome that beauty can be found in the imperfections. We're all individual and wonderfully imperfect. Thanks for sharing it with me!

session_11.speaker: Sarah
session_11.text: Thanks, Jessica. It means a lot to share this with you.

session_11.speaker: Jessica
session_11.text: Great chatting with you! Feel free to reach out any time.

session_12.speaker: Sarah
session_12.text: Hey Jess! How're ya doin'? Recently, I had a not-so-great experience on a hike. I ran into a group of religious conservatives who said something that really upset me. It made me think how much work we still have to do for LGBTQ rights. It's been so helpful to have people around me who accept and support me, so I know I'll be ok!

session_12.speaker: Jessica
session_12.text: Hey Sarah, sorry about the hike. It sucks when people are so closed-minded. Strong support really helps. FYI, I finished another pottery project - want to see a pic?

session_12.speaker: Sarah
session_12.text: Sure thing, Jessica! Can't wait to see your pottery project.  I'm happy you found something that makes you happy. Show me when you can!

session_12.speaker: Jessica
session_12.text: Here it is. Pretty proud of it! It was a great experience. Thoughts?

session_12.speaker: Sarah
session_12.text: That bowl is awesome, Jess! What gave you the idea for all the colors and patterns?

session_12.speaker: Jessica
session_12.text: Thanks, Sarah! I'm obsessed with those, so I made something to catch the eye and make people smile. Plus, painting helps me express my feelings and be creative. Each stroke carries a part of me.

session_12.speaker: Sarah
session_12.text: That's amazing! You put so much effort and passion into it. Your creativity really shines. Seeing how art can be a source of self-expression and growth is truly inspiring. You're killing it!

session_12.speaker: Jessica
session_12.text: Thanks, Sarah! Your words really mean a lot. I've always felt a strong connection to art, and it's been a huge learning experience. It's both a sanctuary and a source of comfort. I'm so glad to have something that brings me so much happiness and fulfillment.

session_12.speaker: Sarah
session_12.text: Glad you found something that makes you so happy! Surrounding ourselves with things that bring us joy is important. Life's too short to do anything else!

session_12.speaker: Jessica
session_12.text: Agreed, Sarah. Life's tough but it's worth it when we have things that make us happy.

session_12.speaker: Sarah
session_12.text: Definitely, Jess! Finding those happy moments and clinging to them is key. It's what keeps us going, even when life's hard. I'm lucky to have people like you to remind me.

session_12.speaker: Jessica
session_12.text: Yeah, same here Sarah. You make life's struggles more bearable.

session_12.speaker: Sarah
session_12.text: Thanks, Jessica! It means a lot having you in my corner. Appreciate our friendship!

session_12.speaker: Jessica
session_12.text: I appreciate our friendship too, Sarah. You've always been there for me.

session_12.speaker: Sarah
session_12.text: I'm always here for you, Jess! We had a blast last year at the Pride fest. Those supportive friends definitely make everything worth it!

session_12.speaker: Jessica
session_12.text: That was a blast! So much fun with the whole gang! Wanna do a family outing this summer?

session_12.speaker: Sarah
session_12.text: Right, it was so much fun! We could do a family outting, or wanna plan something special for this summer, just us two? It'd be a great chance to catch up and explore nature! What do you think?

session_12.speaker: Jessica
session_12.text: Sounds great, Sarah! Let's plan something special!

session_12.speaker: Sarah
session_12.text: Sounds great, Jess! We'll make some awesome memories!

session_12.speaker: Jessica
session_12.text: Yeah, Sarah! I'll start thinking about what we can do.

session_12.speaker: Sarah
session_12.text: Yeah, Jess! Life's all about creating memories. Can't wait for the trip!

session_13.speaker: Sarah
session_13.text: Hi Jessica! Hope you're doing good. Guess what I did this week? I took the first step towards becoming a mom - I applied to adoption agencies! It's a big decision, but I think I'm ready to give all my love to a child. I got lots of help from this adoption advice/assistance group I attended. It was great!

session_13.speaker: Jessica
session_13.text: Sarah, congrats! So proud of you for taking this step. How does it feel? Also, do you have any pets?

session_13.speaker: Sarah
session_13.text: Thanks, Jess! Exciting but kinda nerve-wracking. Parenting's such a big responsibility. And yup, I do- Oscar, my guinea pig. He's been great. How are your pets?

session_13.speaker: Jessica
session_13.text: Yeah, it's normal to be both excited and nervous with a big decision. And thanks for asking, they're good- we got another cat named Bailey too. Here's a pic of Oliver. Can you show me one of Oscar?

session_13.speaker: Sarah
session_13.text: He's so cute! What’s the funniest thing Oliver's done? And sure, check out this pic of him eating parsley! Veggies are his fave!

session_13.speaker: Jessica
session_13.text: Oliver's hilarious! He hid his bone in my slipper once! Cute, right? Almost as silly as when I got to feed a horse a carrot.

session_13.speaker: Sarah
session_13.text: That's so funny! I used to go horseback riding with my dad when I was a kid, we'd go through the fields, feeling the wind. It was so special. I've always had a love for horses!

session_13.speaker: Jessica
session_13.text: Wow, that sounds great - I agree, they're awesome. Here's a photo of my horse painting I did recently.

session_13.speaker: Sarah
session_13.text: Wow, Jessica, that's amazing! Love all the details and how you got the horse's grace and strength. Do you like painting animals?

session_13.speaker: Jessica
session_13.text: Thanks, Sarah! Glad you like it. Yeah, I love to. It's peaceful and special. Horses have such grace! Do you like to paint too?

session_13.speaker: Sarah
session_13.text: Painting's great for expressing myself. I love creating art! Here's a recent self-portrait I made last week.

session_13.speaker: Jessica
session_13.text: Sarah, that's great! The blue's really powerful, huh? How'd you feel while painting it?

session_13.speaker: Sarah
session_13.text: Thanks, Jess! I felt liberated and empowered doing it. Painting helps me explore my identity and be true to myself. It's definitely therapeutic.

session_13.speaker: Jessica
session_13.text: Wow, Sarah, that's great! Art's awesome for showing us who we really are and getting in touch with ourselves. What else helps you out?

session_13.speaker: Sarah
session_13.text: Thanks, Jessica. Art gives me a sense of freedom, but so does having supportive people around, promoting LGBTQ rights and being true to myself. I want to live authentically and help others to do the same.

session_13.speaker: Jessica
session_13.text: Wow, Sarah! That's amazing. You really care about being real and helping others. Wishing you the best on your adoption journey!

session_13.speaker: Sarah
session_13.text: Thanks, Jessica! I really appreciate it. Excited for the future! Bye!

session_13.speaker: Jessica
session_13.text: Bye Sarah. I'm here for you. Take care of yourself.

session_14.speaker: Sarah
session_14.text: Hey, Jess! How's it going? There's something I want to tell you. I went hiking last week and got into a bad spot with some people. It really bugged me, so I tried to apologize to them.

session_14.speaker: Jessica
session_14.text: Wow, Sarah! Sorry that happened to you. It's tough when those things happen, but it's great you apologized. Takes a lot of courage and maturity! What do you think of this?

session_14.speaker: Sarah
session_14.text: Thanks, Jessica! That plate is awesome! Did you make it?

session_14.speaker: Jessica
session_14.text: Yeah, I made it in pottery class yesterday. I love it! Pottery's so relaxing and creative. Have you tried it yet?

session_14.speaker: Sarah
session_14.text: Nah, I haven't. I've been busy painting - here's something I just finished.

session_14.speaker: Jessica
session_14.text: Wow Sarah, that looks amazing! Those colors are so vivid, it really looks like a real sunset. What gave you the idea to paint it?

session_14.speaker: Sarah
session_14.text: Thanks, Jessica! I painted it after I visited the beach last week. Just seeing the sun dip below the horizon, all the amazing colors - it was amazing and calming. So I just had to try to capture that feeling in my painting.

session_14.speaker: Jessica
session_14.text: Wow, the beach really inspired you. The art really took me to that moment and I can feel the serenity. You captured the sunset perfectly, so peaceful!

session_14.speaker: Sarah
session_14.text: Thanks Jess, really appreciate your kind words. It means a lot to me that you can feel the sense of peace and serenity. Makes me feel connected.

session_14.speaker: Jessica
session_14.text: I feel the same way! Art is so cool like that - it connects us and helps us understand each other. I was actually just remembering yesterday, spending the day with my fam volunteering at a homeless shelter. It was hard to see how neglected some people are, but it was great to feel like we could make a difference.

session_14.speaker: Sarah
session_14.text: Wow, Jess, you're amazing! Volunteering and making a difference- it's so heartwarming. You're an inspiration to us all!

session_14.speaker: Jessica
session_14.text: Thanks, Sarah! I really appreciate your help and motivation. What made you decide to transition and join the transgender community?

session_14.speaker: Sarah
session_14.text: Finding a community where I'm accepted, loved and supported has really meant a lot to me. It's made a huge difference to have people who get what I'm going through. Stuff like this mural are really special to me!

session_14.speaker: Jessica
session_14.text: Sarah, glad you found a supportive community! Can you tell me more about why it's special to you?

session_14.speaker: Sarah
session_14.text: The rainbow flag mural is important to me as it reflects the courage and strength of the trans community. The eagle symbolizes freedom and pride, representing my own resilience and that of others.

session_14.speaker: Jessica
session_14.text: I'm in awe of your courage as a trans person. Have you made any more art lately?

session_14.speaker: Sarah
session_14.text: Thanks, Jess! I made this stained glass window to remind myself and others that within us all is the key to discovering our true potential and living our best life.

session_14.speaker: Jessica
session_14.text: Wow, Sarah, that looks amazing! What inspired it?

session_14.speaker: Sarah
session_14.text: Thanks! It was made for a local church and shows time changing our lives. I made it to show my own journey as a transgender woman and how we should accept growth and change.

session_14.speaker: Jessica
session_14.text: Wow, Sarah!  All those colors are incredible and the story it tells is so inspiring.

session_14.speaker: Sarah
session_14.text: Thanks, Jess! Glad you like it. It's a symbol of togetherness, to celebrate differences and be that much closer. I'd love to make something like this next!

session_14.speaker: Jessica
session_14.text: Wow, that's gorgeous! Where did you find it?

session_14.speaker: Sarah
session_14.text: I was out walking in my neighborhood when I came across this cool rainbow sidewalk for Pride Month. It was so vibrant and welcoming, I had to take a picture! It reminds us that love and acceptance are everywhere—even where we least expect it.

session_14.speaker: Jessica
session_14.text: That's so nice, Sarah! Art can be in the most unlikely places. Love and acceptance really can be found everywhere.

session_14.speaker: Sarah
session_14.text: Agreed, Jess! Art can be a real mood-booster - I saw someone drawing on the ground the other day and it made me so happy. Creativity sure can lighten someone's day.

session_14.speaker: Jessica
session_14.text: Wow, Sarah, that's so nice! The colors are so bright and the flowers are so pretty. Art is such a source of joy.

session_14.speaker: Sarah
session_14.text: Thanks, Jess! Art gives me so much joy. It helps me show my feelings and freeze gorgeous moments, like a bouquet of flowers.

session_14.speaker: Jessica
session_14.text: Wow, did you make that? It looks so real!

session_14.speaker: Sarah
session_14.text: Yeah, definitely! Drawing flowers is one of my faves. Appreciating nature and sharing it is great. What about you, Jess? What type of art do you love?

session_14.speaker: Jessica
session_14.text: Painting landscapes and still life is my favorite! Nature's amazing, here's a painting I did recently.

session_14.speaker: Sarah
session_14.text: Wow, Jess! Any more paintings coming up?

session_14.speaker: Jessica
session_14.text: I'm feeling inspired by autumn so I'm planning a few. You got any cool art projects coming up?

session_14.speaker: Sarah
session_14.text: I'm putting together an LGBTQ art show next month and I'm gonna show my paintings. Super stoked!

session_14.speaker: Jessica
session_14.text: Wow, Sarah, that's awesome! Can't wait to see your show - the LGBTQ community needs more platforms like this!

session_14.speaker: Sarah
session_14.text: Yeah Jess, stoked! Gonna be a great night featuring LGBTQ artists and their awesome talents. We want it to spread understanding and acceptance - let's make it happen!

session_15.speaker: Sarah
session_15.text: Hey Jessica, great to hear from you. What's been up since we talked?

session_15.speaker: Jessica
session_15.text: Hey Sarah! Since we last spoke, I took my kids to a park yesterday. They had fun exploring and playing. It was nice seeing them have a good time outdoors. Time flies, huh? What's new with you?

session_15.speaker: Sarah
session_15.text: Wow, your kids had so much fun at the park! Being outdoors can be really enjoyable. A lot happened since our last chat. I've been chasing my ambitions and had the chance to volunteer at an LGBTQ+ youth center. It was so gratifying to talk to similar young people. It made me remember how essential it is to be kind and show support.

session_15.speaker: Jessica
session_15.text: That sounds great, Sarah. Volunteering is a great way to meet people. Creating community and supporting each other, especially for kids, is really important. How did you feel about your time there? Anything that sticks out to you?

session_15.speaker: Sarah
session_15.text: I loved it. It was awesome to see how strong the young people were, with all the challenges they face. I felt fulfilled guiding and supporting them. I even got to let them know they're not alone by sharing my story. Such a powerful, emotional experience.

session_15.speaker: Jessica
session_15.text: Was connecting with those young folks meaningful for you?

session_15.speaker: Sarah
session_15.text: It was so special to me. It reminded me of my own struggles in the past and how I felt alone. I was glad I could share my story and offer them support - it felt like I could make a difference.

session_15.speaker: Jessica
session_15.text: That's great. Sharing your story and support might make a difference for a long time. What do you hope to do next time?

session_15.speaker: Sarah
session_15.text: I'm definitely carrying on volunteering at the youth center. It's an important part of my life and I've made strong connections with people there. I really believe in community and supporting each other. So I wanna keep making a difference.

session_15.speaker: Jessica
session_15.text: That's great news, Sarah! Love seeing your dedication to helping others. Any specific projects or activities you're looking forward to there?

session_15.speaker: Sarah
session_15.text: We're putting together a talent show for the kids next month. I'm looking forward to seeing how much fun everyone has and how proud they'll feel of their talents!

session_15.speaker: Jessica
session_15.text: That's so cool, Sarah! That's a great way to show off and be proud of everyone's skills. You know I love live music. Can't wait to hear about it!

session_15.speaker: Sarah
session_15.text: Wow! Did you see that band?

session_15.speaker: Jessica
session_15.text: Yeah, that pic was from a show I went to. It was so much fun and reminded me of how music brings us together.

session_15.speaker: Sarah
session_15.text: Wow, what a fun moment! What's the band?

session_15.speaker: Jessica
session_15.text: "Summer Sounds"- The playing an awesome pop song that got everyone dancing and singing. It was so fun and lively!

session_15.speaker: Sarah
session_15.text: That sounds great! Music brings us together and brings joy. Playing and singing let me express myself and connect with others - love it! So cathartic and uplifting.

session_15.speaker: Jessica
session_15.text: Cool! What type of music do you play?

session_15.speaker: Sarah
session_15.text: Guitar's mostly my thing. Playing it helps me get my emotions out.

session_15.speaker: Jessica
session_15.text: That's awesome! What type of guitar? Been playing long?

session_15.speaker: Sarah
session_15.text: I started playing acoustic guitar about five years ago; it's been a great way to express myself and escape into my emotions.

session_15.speaker: Jessica
session_15.text: Music's amazing, isn't it? Any songs that have deep meaning for you?

session_15.speaker: Sarah
session_15.text: Yeah totally! "Brave" by Sara Bareilles has a lot of significance for me. It's about being courageous and fighting for what's right. Whenever I hear this jam, I think about the paths I've taken and the progress I've made.

session_15.speaker: Jessica
session_15.text: That's a gorgeous song, Sarah. It really fits with your journey and your determination to make a difference. Music can be so inspiring and uplifting.

session_15.speaker: Sarah
session_15.text: Thanks, Jessica! Appreciate it. You play any instruments?

session_15.speaker: Jessica
session_15.text: Yeah, I play clarinet! Started when I was young and it's been great. Expression of myself and a way to relax.

session_15.speaker: Sarah
session_15.text: Cool! Got any fav tunes?

session_15.speaker: Jessica
session_15.text: I'm a fan of both classical like Bach and Mozart, as well as modern music like Ed Sheeran's "Perfect".

session_16.speaker: Sarah
session_16.text: Hey Jess, long time no chat! I had a wicked day out with the gang last weekend - we went biking and saw some pretty cool stuff. It was so refreshing, and the pic I'm sending is just stunning, eh?

session_16.speaker: Jessica
session_16.text: Hey Sarah! It's so good to hear from you! That pic is so beautiful, the colors really pop. Biking sounds like a great way to get out in nature. We went camping with the kids a few weeks ago, had a blast exploring the forest and hiking. Nature can be so refreshing for your soul. Any plans coming up?

session_16.speaker: Sarah
session_16.text: Jessica, that photo's amazing! I love all the yellow leaves, it looks so cozy. That sounds like fun! Seeing how excited they get for the little things is awesome, it's so contagious.

session_16.speaker: Jessica
session_16.text: Thanks, Sarah! It's awesome seeing the kids get excited learning something new about nature. Those moments make being a parent worth it. We roasted marshmallows and shared stories around the campfire. Those simple moments make the best memories. What inspires you with your volunteering?

session_16.speaker: Sarah
session_16.text: I'm inspired seeing my work make a difference for the LGBTQ+ community. Knowing I'm helping create a more loving world is amazing. I'm really thankful for my friends, family and mentors' support. It inspires me to keep making art, too.

session_16.speaker: Jessica
session_16.text: Wow, Sarah, that looks awesome! I love how it shows the togetherness and power you were talking about. How long have you been creating art?

session_16.speaker: Sarah
session_16.text: Since I was 17 or so. I find it soempowering and cathartic. It's amazing how art can show things that are hard to put into words. How long have you been into art?

session_16.speaker: Jessica
session_16.text: Seven years now, and I've finally found my real muses: painting and pottery. It's so calming and satisfying. Check out my pottery creation in the pic!

session_16.speaker: Sarah
session_16.text: Jessica, those bowls are amazing! They each have such cool designs. I love that you chose pottery for your art. Painting and drawing have helped me express my feelings and explore my gender identity. Creating art was really important to me during my transition - it helped me understand and accept myself. I'm so grateful.

session_16.speaker: Jessica
session_16.text: Thanks, Sarah! It has really helped me out. I love how it's both a creative outlet and a form of therapy. Have you ever thought about trying it or another art form?

session_16.speaker: Sarah
session_16.text: I haven't done pottery yet, but I'm game for trying new art. I might try it sometime! Check out this piece I made!

session_16.speaker: Jessica
session_16.text: Wow, Sarah! This painting is awesome. Love the red and blue. What gave you the idea?

session_16.speaker: Sarah
session_16.text: Thanks, Jessica! I made this painting to show my path as a trans woman. The red and blue are for the binary gender system, and the mix of colors means smashing that rigid thinking. It's a reminder to love my authentic self - it's taken a while to get here but I'm finally proud of who I am.

session_16.speaker: Jessica
session_16.text: Wow, Sar, that painting is amazing! You've made so much progress. I'm super proud of you for being your true self. What effect has the journey had on your relationships?

session_16.speaker: Sarah
session_16.text: Thanks, Jessica. It's definitely changed them. Some close friends kept supporting me, but a few weren't able to handle it. It wasn't easy, but I'm much happier being around those who accept and love me. Now my relationships feel more genuine.

session_16.speaker: Jessica
session_16.text: Sarah, it's got to be tough dealing with those changes. Glad you've found people who uplift and accept you! Here's to a good time at the café last weekend - they even had thoughtful signs like this! It brings me so much happiness.

session_16.speaker: Sarah
session_16.text: Whoa, Jess, that sign looks serious. Did anything happen?

session_16.speaker: Jessica
session_16.text: The sign was just a precaution, I had a great time. But thank you for your concern, you're so thoughtful!

session_16.speaker: Sarah
session_16.text: Phew! Glad it all worked out and you had a good time at the park!

session_16.speaker: Jessica
session_16.text: Yeah, it was so much fun! Those joyful moments definitely show us life's beauty.

session_17.speaker: Sarah
session_17.text: Hey Jess, what's up? Long time no see! I just contacted my mentor for adoption advice. I'm ready to be a mom and share my love and family. It's a great feeling. Anything new with you? Anything exciting going on?

session_17.speaker: Jessica
session_17.text: Hey Sarah! Great to hear from you! Wow, what an amazing journey. Congrats!

session_17.speaker: Sarah
session_17.text: Thanks, Jessica! I'm stoked to start this new chapter. It's been a dream to adopt and provide a safe, loving home for kids who need it. Do you have any experience with adoption, or know anyone who's gone through the process?

session_17.speaker: Jessica
session_17.text: Yeah, a buddy of mine adopted last year. It was a long process, but now they're super happy with their new kid. Makes me feel like maybe I should do it too!

session_17.speaker: Sarah
session_17.text: That's great news about your friend! It can be tough, but so worth it. It's a great way to add to your family and show your love. If you ever do it, let me know — I'd love to help in any way I can.

session_17.speaker: Jessica
session_17.text: Thanks, Sarah! Appreciate your help. Got any tips for getting started on it?

session_17.speaker: Sarah
session_17.text: Yep! Do your research and find an adoption agency or lawyer. They'll help with the process and provide all the info. Gather documents like references, financial info and medical checks. Don't forget to prepare emotionally, since the wait can be hard. It's all worth it in the end though.

session_17.speaker: Jessica
session_17.text: Thanks for the tip, Sarah. Doing research and readying myself emotionally makes sense. I'll do that. BTW, recently I had a setback. Last month I got hurt and had to take a break from pottery, which I use for self-expression and peace.

session_17.speaker: Sarah
session_17.text: Oh man, sorry to hear that, Jessica. I hope you're okay. Pottery's a great way to relax, so it must have been tough taking a break. Need any help?

session_17.speaker: Jessica
session_17.text: Thanks, Sarah. It was tough, but I'm doing ok. Been reading that book you recommended a while ago and painting to keep busy.

session_17.speaker: Sarah
session_17.text: Cool that you have creative outlets. Got any paintings to show? I'd love to check them out.

session_17.speaker: Jessica
session_17.text: Yeah, Here's one I did last week. It's inspired by the sunsets. The colors make me feel calm. What have you been up to lately, artistically?

session_17.speaker: Sarah
session_17.text: Wow Jess, that's stunning! Love the colors and the chilled-out sunset vibe. What made you paint it? I've been trying out abstract stuff recently. It's kinda freeing, just putting my feelings on the canvas without too much of a plan. It's like a cool form of self-expression.

session_17.speaker: Jessica
session_17.text: Thanks, Sarah! I painted it because it was calming. I've done an abstract painting too, take a look! I love how art lets us get our emotions out.

session_17.speaker: Sarah
session_17.text: Wow, that looks great! The blue adds so much to it. What feelings were you hoping to portray?

session_17.speaker: Jessica
session_17.text: I wanted a peaceful blue streaks to show tranquility. Blue calms me, so I wanted the painting to have a serene vibe while still having lots of vibrant colors.

session_17.speaker: Sarah
session_17.text: Yeah, it's very calming. It's awesome how art can show emotions. By the way, I went to a poetry reading last Fri - it was really powerful! Ever been to one?

session_17.speaker: Jessica
session_17.text: Nope, never been to something like that. What was it about? What made it so special?

session_17.speaker: Sarah
session_17.text: It was a transgender poetry reading where transgender people shared their stories through poetry. It was extra special 'cause it was a safe place for self-expression and it was really empowering to hear others share and celebrate their identities.

session_17.speaker: Jessica
session_17.text: Wow, sounds amazing! What was the event like? Those posters are great!

session_17.speaker: Sarah
session_17.text: The room was electric with energy and support! The posters were amazing, so much pride and strength! It inspired me to make some art.

session_17.speaker: Jessica
session_17.text: That's awesome, Sarah! You drew it? What does it mean to you?

session_17.speaker: Sarah
session_17.text: Thanks, Jessica! Yeah, I drew it. It stands for freedom and being real. It's like a nudge to always stay true to myself and embrace my womanhood.

session_17.speaker: Jessica
session_17.text: I love it. Showing off our true selves is the best thing ever.

session_17.speaker: Sarah
session_17.text: Yep, Jessica! Being ourselves is such a great feeling. It's an ongoing adventure of learning and growing.

session_17.speaker: Jessica
session_17.text: Yep, Sarah. Life's about learning and exploring. Glad we can be on this trip together.

session_18.speaker: Jessica
session_18.text: Hey Sarah, that roadtrip this past weekend was insane! We were all freaked when my son got into an accident. We were so lucky he was okay. It was a real scary experience. Thankfully it's over now. What's been up since we last talked?

session_18.speaker: Sarah
session_18.text: Oops, sorry 'bout the accident! Must have been traumatizing for you guys. Thank goodness your son's okay. Life sure can be a roller coaster.

session_18.speaker: Jessica
session_18.text: Yeah, our trip got off to a bad start. I was really scared when we got into the accident. Thankfully, my son's ok and that was a reminder that life is precious and to cherish our family.

session_18.speaker: Sarah
session_18.text: Glad your son is okay, Jessica. Life's unpredictable, but moments like these remind us how important our loved ones are. Family's everything.

session_18.speaker: Jessica
session_18.text: Yeah, you're right, Sarah. Family's super important to me. Especially after the accident, I've thought a lot about how much I need them. They mean the world to me and I'm so thankful to have them. Thankfully, they enjoyed the Grand Canyon a lot!

session_18.speaker: Sarah
session_18.text: The kids look so cute, Jess! I bet they bring lots of joy. How did they handle the accident?

session_18.speaker: Jessica
session_18.text: Thanks! They were scared but we reassured them and explained their brother would be OK. They're tough kids.

session_18.speaker: Sarah
session_18.text: Kids are amazingly resilient in tough situations. They have an amazing ability to bounce back.

session_18.speaker: Jessica
session_18.text: They're really amazing. Wish I was that resilient too. But they give me the strength to keep going.

session_18.speaker: Sarah
session_18.text: Our loved ones give us strength to tackle any challenge - it's amazing!

session_18.speaker: Jessica
session_18.text: Yeah, Sarah. Totally agree. They're my biggest motivation and support.

session_18.speaker: Sarah
session_18.text: It's so sweet to see your love for your family, Jessica. They really are your rock.

session_18.speaker: Jessica
session_18.text: Thanks, Sarah. They're a real support. Appreciate them a lot.

session_18.speaker: Sarah
session_18.text: Glad you've got people to lean on, Jessica. It helps during tougher times.

session_18.speaker: Jessica
session_18.text: Yeah for sure. Having my fam around helps a lot. It makes hard times easier.

session_18.speaker: Sarah
session_18.text: Wow, great pic! Is that recent? Looks like you all had fun!

session_18.speaker: Jessica
session_18.text: Thanks, Sarah! Yup, we just did it yesterday! The kids loved it and it was a nice way to relax after the road trip.

session_18.speaker: Sarah
session_18.text: Glad you got some R&R after the drive. Nature sure seems to refresh us, huh?

session_18.speaker: Jessica
session_18.text: Absolutely! It really helps me reset and recharge. I love camping trips with my fam, 'cause nature brings such peace and serenity.

session_18.speaker: Sarah
session_18.text: Wow, that's awesome! What do you love most about camping with your fam?

session_18.speaker: Jessica
session_18.text: It's a chance to be present and together. We bond over stories, campfires and nature. It's so peaceful waking up to the sound of birds and the smell of fresh air - it always refreshes my soul.

session_18.speaker: Sarah
session_18.text: That's so peaceful and calming, Jessica! I can picture waking up to nature. It's great that you get to spend quality, tranquil time with your family.

session_18.speaker: Jessica
session_18.text: Thanks, Sarah! This is a great time. Nature and quality time, can't beat it!

session_18.speaker: Sarah
session_18.text: Yeah totally! They're priceless. Lucky you!

session_19.speaker: Sarah
session_19.text: Woohoo Jessica! I passed the adoption agency interviews last Friday! I'm so excited and thankful. This is a big move towards my goal of having a family.

session_19.speaker: Jessica
session_19.text: Congrats, Sarah! Adoption sounds awesome. I'm so happy for you. These figurines I bought yesterday remind me of family love. Tell me, what's your vision for the future?

session_19.speaker: Sarah
session_19.text: Thanks so much, Jessica! It's beautiful! It really brings home how much love's in families - both blood and the ones we choose. I hope to build my own family and put a roof over kids who haven't had that before. For me, adoption is a way of giving back and showing love and acceptance.

session_19.speaker: Jessica
session_19.text: Wow, Sarah, that's awesome. Giving a home to needy kids is such a loving way to build a family. Those kids will be so supported and happy in their new home.

session_19.speaker: Sarah
session_19.text: Thanks, Jessica. My dream is to create a safe and loving home for these kids. Love and acceptance should be everyone's right, and I want them to experience it.

session_19.speaker: Jessica
session_19.text: I totally agree, Sarah. Everyone deserves that. It's awesome to see how passionate you are about helping these kids.

session_19.speaker: Sarah
session_19.text: Thanks, Jess. Finding self-acceptance was a long process, but now I'm ready to offer love and support to those who need it. It's empowering to make a positive difference in someone's life.

session_19.speaker: Jessica
session_19.text: That must have been tough for you, Sarah. Respect for finding acceptance and helping others with what you've been through. You're so strong and inspiring.

session_19.speaker: Sarah
session_19.text: Thanks, Jessica. Transitioning wasn't easy and acceptance wasn't either, but the help I got from friends, family and people I looked up to was invaluable. They boosted me through tough times and helped me find out who I really am. That's why I want to pass that same support to anyone who needs it. Bringing others comfort and helping them grow brings me such joy.

session_19.speaker: Jessica
session_19.text: I'm so happy for you, Sarah. You found your true self and now you're helping others. You're so inspiring!

session_19.speaker: Sarah
session_19.text: Thanks, Jessica. Your support really means a lot. This journey has been amazing and I'm grateful I get to share it and help others with theirs. It's a real gift.

session_19.speaker: Jessica
session_19.text: Absolutely! I'm so glad we can always be there for each other.

session_19.speaker: Sarah
session_19.text: Glad you agree, Sarah. Appreciate the support of those close to me. Their encouragement made me who I am.

session_19.speaker: Jessica
session_19.text: Glad you had support. Being yourself is great!

session_19.speaker: Sarah
session_19.text: Yeah, that's true! It's so freeing to just be yourself and live honestly. We can really accept who we are and be content.
