session_9.text: Wow, that's great to hear! What books do you enjoy? I'm always up for some new book recommendations.

session_9.speaker: Noah
session_9.text: I love this series. It has adventures, magic, and great characters - it's a must-read!

session_9.speaker: Julia
session_9.text: Heard of that series! It's been on my list forever. Thanks for the recommendation, Noah. I'm definitely going to check it out!

session_9.speaker: Noah
session_9.text: No problem, glad to see an interest. Let me know what you think when you check it out.

session_9.speaker: Julia
session_9.text: Thanks Noah! I'll definitely let you know my thoughts. Take care and have a great day!

session_9.speaker: Noah
session_9.text: See you! Good chatting with you! Have a great day!

session_10.speaker: Julia
session_10.text: Hey Noah, how's it going? I took your reccomendation and watched "The Lord of the Rings" Trilogy last night! It was awesome!

session_10.speaker: Noah
session_10.text: Glad to hear you enjoyed it! It's probably the greatest trilogy of all time! As for me, life's been ok, just taking care of this.

session_10.speaker: Julia
session_10.text: Wow, Noah! I'm proud of what you did. Your gaming room looks great - have you been gaming a lot recently?

session_10.speaker: Noah
session_10.text: Gaming has been my focus - practicing a lot and even winning a few tournaments. Last week I won my second tournament!

session_10.speaker: Julia
session_10.text: Wow, congrats! What game were you playing?

session_10.speaker: Noah
session_10.text: Thanks! I usually play CS:GO, but I tried my hand at the local Street Fighter tournament this time since I play that game a lot with my friends, and turns out I'm really good!

session_10.speaker: Julia
session_10.text: Nice! That must have been a surprise. How did it feel to finally win one?

session_10.speaker: Noah
session_10.text: It was super awesome! So much adrenaline went into that last match, and the other finalist even shook my hand! Enough about me though, how about you? What have you been up to?

session_10.speaker: Julia
session_10.text: Not much is new other than the screenplay. Been working on some projects and testing out dairy-free dessert recipes for friends and fam. Here's a pic of a cake I made recently!

session_10.speaker: Noah
session_10.text: That looks really good! I love the way the frosting turned out!

session_10.speaker: Julia
session_10.text: Thanks! It's dairy-free vanilla with strawberry filling and coconut cream frosting. I gotta say, I really like your coconut reccomendation you gave a while back!

session_10.speaker: Noah
session_10.text: Wow, Julia, that looks amazing! I bet it tastes great - you're so talented at making dairy-free desserts!

session_10.speaker: Julia
session_10.text: Thanks Noah! I really appreciate it. I love experimenting in the kitchen, coming up with something tasty. Cooking and baking are my creative outlets. Especially when I'm snackin' dairy-free, trying to make the desserts just as delicious - it's a rewarding challenge! Seeing the smiles on everyone's faces when they try it - it's a total win!

session_10.speaker: Noah
session_10.text: That's great, Julia! It must be so rewarding to see everyone enjoying your creations. Keep up the good work!

session_10.speaker: Julia
session_10.text: Thanks, Noah! Appreciate all the help. Gonna keep trying new things. See ya later!

session_10.speaker: Noah
session_10.text: Bye!

session_11.speaker: Julia
session_11.text: Hey Noah! Great to hear from you! Quite a week since we last talked - something awesome happened to me!

session_11.speaker: Noah
session_11.text: Hey Jo! Great hearing from you! What happened?

session_11.speaker: Julia
session_11.text: I went hiking and found some more amazing trails in my town. It was such an awesome experience! I think I am an expert hiker now.

session_11.speaker: Noah
session_11.text: Sounds great, Jo! Happy you had an awesome experience. Did you happen to take any photos of it?

session_11.speaker: Julia
session_11.text: Yeah, I did! Loved this spot on the hike. The rush of the water was so soothing.

session_11.speaker: Noah
session_11.text: Wow, looks great! Where did you take this picture? I love the dark sky and green scenery.

session_11.speaker: Julia
session_11.text: Thanks! I took this photo at a beautiful location called Whispering Falls. It was really peaceful and serene.

session_11.speaker: Noah
session_11.text: I wish I could have been there! Your hikes sound like a blast.

session_11.speaker: Julia
session_11.text: It was awesome, Noah. The sound of that place and the beauty of nature made me so calm and peaceful. Everything else faded away and all that mattered was the present.

session_11.speaker: Noah
session_11.text: That's great. Glad you found a spot that calms you down - nature sure can be a break from the craziness.

session_11.speaker: Julia
session_11.text: Nature totally inspires me and it's so calming to be surrounded by its beauty. Hiking has opened up a whole new world for me and I feel like a different person now.

session_11.speaker: Noah
session_11.text: Wow, Jo, that's really cool! It's great to have something that gets those creative juices flowing.

session_11.speaker: Julia
session_11.text: I always feel like I could write a whole movie when I'm out there in cool places like that!

session_11.speaker: Noah
session_11.text: Wow! That's really cool that it inspires you that much! For me I just get deep in thought and think about my life or new recipes.

session_11.speaker: Julia
session_11.text: I think about my life too sometimes when I'm out and about, but there was something special about these trails that made me feel like writing a drama.

session_11.speaker: Noah
session_11.text: Hey, we should go together sometime, don't you think? Maybe I'll start to think of a drama myself and publish my own screenplay.

session_11.speaker: Julia
session_11.text: Haha, now that would be something! Sure, you should come down and join me on the trails sometime!

session_11.speaker: Noah
session_11.text: Sounds like a plan! Thanks for the invite Julia!

session_11.speaker: Julia
session_11.text: Sure thing Noah! See you later!

session_11.speaker: Noah
session_11.text: See ya!

session_12.speaker: Noah
session_12.text: Hey Julia! How've you been? Been a busy week since we talked.

session_12.speaker: Julia
session_12.text: Hey Noah! Just finished something - pretty wild journey!

session_12.speaker: Noah
session_12.text: Way to go! I just got a new addition to the family, this is Max!

session_12.speaker: Julia
session_12.text: Wow, he's adorable! How long have you had him? I can see why you're thrilled!

session_12.speaker: Noah
session_12.text: Thanks! It's awesome - he's adopted and so full of energy, and he's filling my life with so much joy. He's even keeping my other pets active.

session_12.speaker: Julia
session_12.text: Pets sure do make life better! Glad Max is bringing you lots of joy.

session_12.speaker: Noah
session_12.text: Yep, totally! Pets make us so much happier and never let us down. Have you thought any more of getting one of your own?

session_12.speaker: Julia
session_12.text: Unfortunately, allergies make it so I don't really want to get any, and I'm too lazy to research alternative pets for my allergies.

session_12.speaker: Noah
session_12.text: Aww, that's unfortunate. It's nice seeing the joy pets bring to others, though. How do you find comfort when you don't have any?

session_12.speaker: Julia
session_12.text: Writing and creative projects are what get me through tough times. I'm also grateful for my supportive friends.

session_12.speaker: Noah
session_12.text: Wow, that's awesome! Those both can definitely be therapeutic. It's great to have such positive relationships that make such a great impact.

session_12.speaker: Julia
session_12.text: Yeah. It's so nice to have friends who understand and appreciate my work - it's priceless being able to talk about it together and receive feedback. Here's a look at what I've been working on – it's been quite a journey, but I made it!

session_12.speaker: Noah
session_12.text: Wow, that looks great Julia! Is that your third one?

session_12.speaker: Julia
session_12.text: Yep! I chose to write about this because it's really personal. It's about loss, identity, and connection. It's a story I've had for ages but just got the guts to write it. It was hard, but I'm so proud of it.

session_12.speaker: Noah
session_12.text: That sounds impressive. You really do like writing about sadness and loss don't you.

session_12.speaker: Julia
session_12.text: Thanks, Noah! Yeah I really do. I had to be vulnerable and dig deep into those topics. But I think meaningful stories come from personal experiences and feelings. It was scary, but I found that I write best when I'm being true to myself - even if it's hard.

session_12.speaker: Noah
session_12.text: Well done, Julia! It takes guts to explore your experiences and feelings. I'm proud of you for staying strong and being true to yourself. Keep it up!

session_12.speaker: Julia
session_12.text: Thanks, Noah! Your support really means a lot. Knowing I've got people like you cheering me on makes this journey way easier.

session_12.speaker: Noah
session_12.text: No worries, Julia! Keep going and reach for your dreams. You've got tons of talent and potential!

session_13.speaker: Noah
session_13.text: Hey Jo! Been ages since we last talked. Here's something cool that happened the other day - I took Max for a walk and ran into this super nice couple who had a dog. It turns out they live close by. We decided to do doggy playdates, which is awesome considering we all need friends for our pets.

session_13.speaker: Julia
session_13.text: Hey Noah! Great to hear from you. Sounds like a nice encounter on your walk. Connecting with others who have pets can be uplifting and rewarding.

session_13.speaker: Noah
session_13.text: It's like fate. Having a walking buddy forMax will be great. He really likes the other dog too!

session_13.speaker: Julia
session_13.text: Awesome! Did you get to know the couple very well? What were they like?

session_13.speaker: Noah
session_13.text: They actually didn't share a whole lot in common with me besides the love of animals, but I think that was all we needed to share in common to be good friends!

session_13.speaker: Julia
session_13.text: That's really cool that you can just go out and meet people like that, keep it up Noah!

session_13.speaker: Noah
session_13.text: Thanks! I just really enjoy watching our pets play with one another. Its like a dream come true seeing my dog so happy.

session_13.speaker: Julia
session_13.text: I can see why having a peaceful presence around could help relieve stress. Having someone or something to come home to for a sense of calm would be helpful for relaxation.

session_13.speaker: Noah
session_13.text: Yep, Julia. It's great! Looky here, I got this new pup for you!

session_13.speaker: Julia
session_13.text: Awww! It's so cute! I love the thought Noah!

session_13.speaker: Noah
session_13.text: Thanks! It's a stuffed animal to remind you of the good vibes.

session_13.speaker: Julia
session_13.text: That's so sweet! I'll cherish that little guy with all my heart!

session_13.speaker: Noah
session_13.text: Yeah! It's like having joy in your pocket. It always makes me grin when I look at it.

session_13.speaker: Julia
session_13.text: That's great, Noah! Appreciate the small joys like that cute stuffed animal. It's a nice reminder!

session_13.speaker: Noah
session_13.text: Agreed, those little things sure do make life better!

session_13.speaker: Julia
session_13.text: I'll always remember those moments that bring us happiness and remind us that life is great!

session_13.speaker: Noah
session_13.text: Sure, Julia! It's all about finding those little things and cherishing them, otherwise it's easy to get down!

session_13.speaker: Julia
session_13.text: Thinking back to the tough times finishing my screenplay made me realize it's those moments that bring joy and make the journey worth it.

session_13.speaker: Noah
session_13.text: Yeah, those little moments make it all worth it, especially during tough times. Enjoying the ride is key.

session_13.speaker: Julia
session_13.text: Appreciating the journey and being aware of those happy moments can be a game-changer! It keeps us focused on our dreams. Can't wait to show it to you. I value your opinion!

session_13.speaker: Noah
session_13.text: Can't wait to see it, Julia! I'm here to support you.

session_13.speaker: Julia
session_13.text: Thanks, Noah! Your support is greatly appreciated. I'll make sure to keep you updated.

session_13.speaker: Noah
session_13.text: No worries! You've got this. Keep it up!

session_14.speaker: Julia
session_14.text: Noah, after finishing my screenplay I got a rejection letter from a major company. It really bummed me out.

session_14.speaker: Noah
session_14.text: Sorry to hear that, Julia. Rejection stinks, but it doesn't mean you're not talented. Don't give up on your dreams!

session_14.speaker: Julia
session_14.text: Thanks, Noah. It can feel like a step back sometimes. But I appreciate your kind words and encouragement.

session_14.speaker: Noah
session_14.text: Sure, just make sure you keep going and believing in yourself. Did something happen with the company?

session_14.speaker: Julia
session_14.text: They just sent me a generic rejection letter without much feedback. It's disheartening not knowing why it didn't work out.

session_14.speaker: Noah
session_14.text: Ugh, that's so frustrating. But don't get discouraged, just keep going.

session_14.speaker: Julia
session_14.text: Yeah, you're right. I won't let this bring me down. Thanks for your support. What have you been up to lately?

session_14.speaker: Noah
session_14.text: I've been doing great - I just won another regional video game tournament last week! It was so cool, plus I met some new people. Connecting with fellow gamers is always awesome.

session_14.speaker: Julia
session_14.text: Way to go, Noah! Congratulations on your victory in the tournament! It must feel great to be recognized for your gaming skills.

session_14.speaker: Noah
session_14.text: Thanks, Julia! Winning was a huge confidence boost and shows my hard work paid off. I'm really happy with my progress.

session_14.speaker: Julia
session_14.text: I am as well! It's great to hear from you about your tournaments throughout the years!

session_14.speaker: Noah
session_14.text: Thanks! I has been a while since my first tournament hasn't it? I appreciate your support!

session_14.speaker: Julia
session_14.text: Anytime Noah! I'm here for you every step of the way.

session_14.speaker: Noah
session_14.text: I talked to some of the guys at the tournament afterwards, and they said they wanted to hang out later!

session_14.speaker: Julia
session_14.text: Sounds like fun! It's good to have friends that share your interests!

session_14.speaker: Noah
session_14.text: For sure! They asked for some tips in how to improve their game, so I said I could help.

session_14.speaker: Julia
session_14.text: Good on you for helping strangers out! Stepping outside your comfort zone is always great.

session_14.speaker: Noah
session_14.text: Thanks, I just like helping people. Do you have any plans for the weekend?

session_14.speaker: Julia
session_14.text: Yep, I'm hiking with some buddies this weekend. We're checking out a new trail with a rad waterfall. Can't wait! Do you have any fun plans?

session_14.speaker: Noah
session_14.text: Sounds great! Have fun with that. I'm organizing a gaming party two weekends later - it'll be hectic but fun!

session_14.speaker: Julia
session_14.text: Oh? Are you going to invite your tournament friends?

session_14.speaker: Noah
session_14.text: Definitely! And some old friends and teamates from other tournaments.

session_14.speaker: Julia
session_14.text: Sounds like fun, Noah! I wish you the best on your party. Have a blast!

session_14.speaker: Noah
session_14.text: Thanks Julia! I'm sure it'll be a blast. I'm even getting everyone custom controller decorations just for coming!

session_14.speaker: Julia
session_14.text: Wow, I bet they'll love that! What a sweet idea.

session_14.speaker: Noah
session_14.text: I know right? Have a great hike. Take lots of pics! See ya later!

session_14.speaker: Julia
session_14.text: Thanks Noah! See you later!

session_15.speaker: Julia
session_15.text: Hey Noah! Yesterday was crazy cool - I wrote a few bits for a screenplay that appeared on the big screen yesterday! It was nerve-wracking but so inspiring to see my words come alive!

session_15.speaker: Noah
session_15.text: Congrats, Julia! Seeing your hard work pay off like that must've felt amazing. I bet it was scary too, but awesome! You're so inspiring. By the way, last time we saw eachother, I noticed a spiderman pin on your purse. Is Spider-Man your favorite superhero, or do you have another fave?

session_15.speaker: Julia
session_15.text: Thanks, Noah! It was a real roller coaster, but seeing the hard work pay off was amazing. Spider-Man has always been a favorite of mine - I mean, who doesn't love Peter Parker's struggles between being a hero and being a person? But I'm kind of a sucker for any superhero - everyone has their own rad story and powers. Do you have a favorite superhero?

session_15.speaker: Noah
session_15.text: That's great, Julia! Iron Man is my top pick. I love his tech and that sarcastic humor. Seeing these figures just makes me feel invincible!

session_15.speaker: Julia
session_15.text: Wow, Noah! That's awesome. I love the tech and funny jokes of Iron Man too. What made you get that figure?

session_15.speaker: Noah
session_15.text: Thanks Julia! I got it because it reminded me of something I love. Its presence in my room is a good reminder to keep working on my goals. Any inspiring things in your room?

session_15.speaker: Julia
session_15.text: My cork board is full of inspiring quotes and pictures for motivation and creativity. It's my little corner of inspiration.

session_15.speaker: Noah
session_15.text: Wow Julia, that sounds great! Could you show me a picture of it?

session_15.speaker: Julia
session_15.text: Here ya go, a pic of my cork board. It's got quotes, photos, and little keepsakes.

session_15.speaker: Noah
session_15.text: That's a great pic of your family! What made you hang it on your cork board?

session_15.speaker: Julia
session_15.text: Thanks, Noah! Having that picture on my cork board reminds me of the love and encouragement from them every day.

session_15.speaker: Noah
session_15.text: That's great, Julia. Family support is invaluable. It's so good to have those reminders.

session_15.speaker: Julia
session_15.text: Absolutely, it means a lot and keeps me going.

session_15.speaker: Noah
session_15.text: I really should start a cork board of my own shouldn't I. That seems like a really valuable thing!

session_15.speaker: Julia
session_15.text: I would definitely recommend it! As long as your willing to explain what it is to your friends.

session_15.speaker: Noah
session_15.text: Of course! Well see you later Julia!

session_15.speaker: Julia
session_15.text: Bye Noah!

session_16.speaker: Julia
session_16.text: Hey Noah, long time no see! How have you been? I just got done submitting my recent screenplay to a film contest just to see how others might like it!

session_16.speaker: Noah
session_16.text: That's really cool Julia! I hope it does well, and I've been doing great! The gaming party was a great success! We even played some Chess afterward just for fun.

session_16.speaker: Julia
session_16.text: Nice! Did your friends like the controller accessories?

session_16.speaker: Noah
session_16.text: Most of them did! I can't say if all of them will continue to use them or not, but that's beside the point.

session_16.speaker: Julia
session_16.text: Yeah Noah, you're right. It doesn't matter if they use it, its the thought that matters right?

session_16.speaker: Noah
session_16.text: Absolutely! There were 7 people that attended, and 6 of them said they'd want to do it again next month!

session_16.speaker: Julia
session_16.text: That sounds like a huge success then! Congrats!

session_16.speaker: Noah
session_16.text: Thanks! On another note, I made vegan ice cream last Friday and shared it with some people in my vegan diet group. It was awesome!

session_16.speaker: Julia
session_16.text: Mm, yum! Can you give me the recipe for that? It sounds like it'd be a good recipe!

session_16.speaker: Noah
session_16.text: Sure thing! I can give it to you tomorrow, how does that sound?

session_16.speaker: Julia
session_16.text: Awesome! I'm going to make it for my family this weekend - can't wait!

session_16.speaker: Noah
session_16.text: Nice one, Julia! Hope you and your family like it. Let me know how it went!

session_16.speaker: Julia
session_16.text: Sure thing! They love it when I make them new things!

session_16.speaker: Noah
session_16.text: Then I have no doubt they'll love the icecream!

session_16.speaker: Julia
session_16.text: Thanks Noah! Your support is greatly appreciated. I'll make sure to keep you updated.

session_16.speaker: Noah
session_16.text: Can't wait to hear about it. Have a great day! Take care.

session_17.speaker: Noah
session_17.text: Hey Julia, check this out! I won my fourth video game tournament on Friday! It was awesome competing and showing off my skills - and the victory was indescribable. I'm really proud that I can make money doing what I love. This one was online!

session_17.speaker: Julia
session_17.text: Congrats, Noah! That's awesome! So proud of you. Your hard work really paid off - keep it up! BTW, I took a road trip for research for my next movie while you were winning. Much-needed break and a chance to explore new places and get inspired.

session_17.speaker: Noah
session_17.text: Thanks, Julia! Your support means a lot to me. That road trip sounds great! Where did you go? Did you discover any interesting places?

session_17.speaker: Julia
session_17.text: Thanks Noah! Appreciate your kind words. I went to Woodhaven, a small town in the Midwest. Got to see some lovely scenery and historic buildings. Checked out the library there, it had a cool old book collection!

session_17.speaker: Noah
session_17.text: That place looks interesting! Did you find any cool books there?

session_17.speaker: Julia
session_17.text: I stumbled upon this super cool book from the 1900s with stories and sketches - so awesome to read about the town and the people living there!

session_17.speaker: Noah
session_17.text: That sounds really interesting! Anyting specific stick out to you about it?

session_17.speaker: Julia
session_17.text: Woodhaven has had an interesting past with lots of cool people. Seeing how much it changed sparked ideas for my next script.

session_17.speaker: Noah
session_17.text: Real-life stories are the best for inspiration. Can't wait to hear about your next one. Keep it up!

session_17.speaker: Julia
session_17.text: Thanks, Noah! I'm stoked about this new script. It's different from my previous work, but it has the potential to be something awesome! I'll be sure to keep you posted.

session_17.speaker: Noah
session_17.text: I'm sure it will do just as well as your last one! Keep on trying and believe in yourself!

session_17.speaker: Julia
session_17.text: Thanks, Noah! Your encouragement really means a lot to me. You're the best for supporting me in my writing journey.

session_17.speaker: Noah
session_17.text: I'm always here for you! You've got so much talent, just keep going for it!

session_17.speaker: Julia
session_17.text: I will! I actually started on a book recently since my movie did well!

session_17.speaker: Noah
session_17.text: Nice! I'm curious, what is it about?

session_17.speaker: Julia
session_17.text: That page specifically has some dialogues exploring loss, redemption, and forgiveness. It's a deep and emotional story that I'm really excited about!

session_17.speaker: Noah
session_17.text: Wow, Julia! It sounds awesome. I'm so excited to see how it all plays out!

session_17.speaker: Julia
session_17.text: Thanks, Noah! I'm so glad you're excited. I've never really tried publishing a book, but this might be the first!

session_17.speaker: Noah
session_17.text: Good luck on that! I'm sure people will recognise you as the same author of the movie you got published and love the book even more.

session_17.speaker: Julia
session_17.text: Thanks, Noah! Your belief in me means a lot. I'll keep doing my best. Thanks for the support!

session_17.speaker: Noah
session_17.text: No problem, Julia. I'm here for you. Your hard work will pay off, I promise. Believe in yourself and your talent - you're incredible!

session_18.speaker: Julia
session_18.text: Hey Noah, long time no talk! I've been busy with writing projects and really going all out with it. It's been the best thing ever - a mix of highs and lows - and my journal's pretty much my rock. Writing's such a huge part of me now.

session_18.speaker: Noah
session_18.text: Hey Julia! Great to hear it! It's amazing how much a certain activity can become a part of our lives. Keep it up, you're inspiring! Is writing your way to solace and creativity?

session_18.speaker: Julia
session_18.text: Yeah, definitely. Writing has become like an escape and a way to express my feelings. It gives me a chance to put all my thoughts and feelings down and make something good out of it. Words just have a magical way of healing.

session_18.speaker: Noah
session_18.text: That's really cool, I like it! It's incredible how words can turn something sad into something special. I'm glad it worked for you. Anything cool happening recently?

session_18.speaker: Julia
session_18.text: Yep. Last week, someone wrote me a letter after reading an online blog post I made about a hard moment in my life. Their words touched me; they said my story had brought them comfort. It was awesome to realize my words had that kind of power. It reminded me why I love writing.

session_18.speaker: Noah
session_18.text: Nice work, Julia! That must feel sureal. Keep it up - you're changing lives!

session_18.speaker: Julia
session_18.text: Thanks, Noah! Really appreciate your kind words. It's knowing that my writing can make a difference that keeps me going, even on tough days. So glad to have this outlet to share my stories and hopefully have an impact. How about you? Anything new since we last talked?

session_18.speaker: Noah
session_18.text: Thanks, Julia! Your words mean a lot. Since we last spoke, I started teaching people how to make this. Sharing my love for dairy-free desserts has been fun and rewarding.

session_18.speaker: Julia
session_18.text: Yum, Noah! I love it when you make coconut milk icecream, it's so good!

session_18.speaker: Noah
session_18.text: I've been really into making this lately - it's creamy, rich, dairy-free and a new recipe! Wanna try it? I can share the recipe with you if you'd like!

session_18.speaker: Julia
session_18.text: I'd love to try it! Thanks for sharing your love for dairy-free desserts. I really appreciate it!

session_18.speaker: Noah
session_18.text: No problem, Julia! Always happy to share them with you. Sending you the recipe now!

session_18.speaker: Julia
session_18.text: Thanks, Noah! Can't wait to surprise my family with something delicious!

session_18.speaker: Noah
session_18.text: No problem, Julia! Wish them luck! Let me know how it goes. Have a blast baking!

session_18.speaker: Julia
session_18.text: Thanks, Noah. I'll keep you posted. Have a great day.

session_18.speaker: Noah
session_18.text: You too!

session_19.speaker: Noah
session_19.text: Woah Julia, I won an international tournament yesterday! It was wild. Gaming has brought me so much success and now I'm able to make a living at something I'm passionate about - I'm loving it.

session_19.speaker: Julia
session_19.text: Congrats, Noah! So proud of you for winning that tournament, that's awesome! Must feel great to turn your passion into a career.

session_19.speaker: Noah
session_19.text: I'm really stoked to see all my hard work paying off! I'm super proud of what I accomplished. On another note, my little dudes got a new tank! Check them out, they're so cute, right?!

session_19.speaker: Julia
session_19.text: Wow Noah, they're adorable! I can see why you enjoy spending time with them. It looks like they have so much more room to swim now!

session_19.speaker: Noah
session_19.text: They're my little buddies, always calm and peaceful. It makes coming home after a long day of gaming better. The tank expansion has made them so happy! How have you been?

session_19.speaker: Julia
session_19.text: I'm good! Was super nervous last week when I shared my book with my writers group but got some great feedback. My hard work is paying off, it's such an awesome feeling!

session_19.speaker: Noah
session_19.text: Wow Jo, you're killing it! Getting this kind of feedback means people are really connecting with your writing. Pretty cool! Did you celebrate?

session_19.speaker: Julia
session_19.text: Thanks, Noah! It feels great knowing that people like my writing. I celebrated by making this delicious treat - yum! Any plans for the weekend?

session_19.speaker: Noah
session_19.text: I'm taking some time off this weekend to chill with my pets. Anything cool happening with you?

session_19.speaker: Julia
session_19.text: I'm relaxing and recharging this weekend with a long walk and some reading. It's a good break.

session_19.speaker: Noah
session_19.text: Looks like we both need a break. I'm glad your able to find a way to recharge! It's so incredibly important to take time off!

session_19.speaker: Julia
session_19.text: Thanks, Noah! I've learned that taking breaks and looking after myself are important for my inspiration and mental health. It's all about finding balance.

session_19.speaker: Noah
session_19.text: Yeah, balance is key! It's so cool how taking care of ourselves helps us be more creative and happier. I'm always looking for something new to read. Got any book recommendations? I've got a lot of books to choose from.

session_19.speaker: Julia
session_19.text: I reccomend finding a fantasy book series to read through. Most fiction series are great reads when your trying to relax.

session_19.speaker: Noah
session_19.text: Good idea! How about this series?

session_19.speaker: Julia
session_19.text: That's a great one! Let me know what you think when your finished!

session_19.speaker: Noah
session_19.text: Sure thing! And since your recommending me a book, I thought I should do the same! I'd really recommend this series. It's got awesome battles and interesting characters.

session_19.speaker: Julia
session_19.text: Wow, that series looks awesome! I'll have to check it out sometime!

session_19.speaker: Noah
session_19.text: You really should! The action scenes are awesome and the plot rocks. Definitely one of my favorites!

session_19.speaker: Julia
session_19.text: Wow, sounds great! I'll definitely add it to my list; thanks for the recommendation!

session_19.speaker: Noah
session_19.text: Enjoy it! Have a good day.

session_19.speaker: Julia
session_19.text: Thanks, Noah! You too! Have a great day. Take care.

session_20.speaker: Noah
session_20.text: Hey Julia! Long time no talk. So much has happened. Look how cute they are! Hanging with them has been a big help, especially recently. Speaking of which, I just had a letdown in a video game tourney - I didn't do too great, even though I tried. It was a setback, but I'm trying to stay positive.

session_20.speaker: Julia
session_20.text: Hey Noah! Cute turtles! Bummer about the setback. Any positive vibes comin' your way? I just revised on of my old recipes and made this!

session_20.speaker: Noah
session_20.text: Hey Julia, yeah it's a bummer that I didn't do well. But it's all part of the learning curve, you know? Also that looks super good! Anyways, how are you holding up?

session_20.speaker: Julia
session_20.text: I'm doing OK, thanks. Just been tinkering with that recipe and a few others. It's helping me find some comfort and getting creative.

session_20.speaker: Noah
session_20.text: What else are you making? It's always satisfying to see the kind of things you do when your in one of those moods!

session_20.speaker: Julia
session_20.text: Been tweaking a dessert recipe to make it yummier and more accessible.

session_20.speaker: Noah
session_20.text: Wow, that sounds great! What flavors are you experimenting with?

session_20.speaker: Julia
session_20.text: Trying out different flavors like chocolate, raspberry, and coconut has been a blast!

session_20.speaker: Noah
session_20.text: Sounds delicious! Are you only trying dairy-free options?

session_20.speaker: Julia
session_20.text: Yeah, since I'm lactose intolerant I'm trying out dairy-free options like coconut or almond milk instead. It's been a fun challenge seeing how to make yummy treats that suit everyone's diets. I even made these dairy-free chocolate coconut cupcakes with raspberry frosting.

session_20.speaker: Noah
session_20.text: Woah, those look great, Julia! It's cool that you make desserts that work for everyone's diets. Do you have any more yummy recipes hiding in there?

session_20.speaker: Julia
session_20.text: Yep! I've been making all sorts of desserts that work for everyone's diets - cookies, pies, cakes - everything! I'll share more recipes with you soon.

session_20.speaker: Noah
session_20.text: Can't wait to try them. Can I join you sometime? I think baking and cooking really brings us together!

session_20.speaker: Julia
session_20.text: Yeah, Noah! A fellow Chef in the kitchen is always a great help! Speaking of which, i'm curious, any more tips for dairy-free baking?

session_20.speaker: Noah
session_20.text: You can use stuff like dairy-free margarine or coconut oil instead of butter, and make sure to check the labels to ensure they're dairy-free. Good luck!

session_20.speaker: Julia
session_20.text: Thanks, Noah! Love your ideas, can't wait to try them out!

session_20.speaker: Noah
session_20.text: No problem! I love to help, so just shoot me a question anytime you need!

session_20.speaker: Julia
session_20.text: Got it Noah, I'll see you soon!

session_20.speaker: Noah
session_20.text: Bye Julia! Good luck!

session_21.speaker: Julia
session_21.text: Hey Noah, long time no see! My laptop crashed last week and I lost all my work - super frustrating! As a writer, my laptop is like half of my lifeline so losing all progress was like a major blow.

session_21.speaker: Noah
session_21.text: Hey Julia, sorry to hear about that. Losing so much progress must be really frustrating. Did you manage to recover anything? Maybe consider backing up your work in the future?

session_21.speaker: Julia
session_21.text: Thanks for the sympathy, Noah. Nothing was recoverable, but now I have an external drive for backups. I never want to go through this again. So, how have you been? Making anything cool?

session_21.speaker: Noah
session_21.text: Hey Julia, I'm no writer like you, but something pretty awesome happened. Last Monday I got to teach people vegan ice cream recipes on my own cooking show! It was a bit nerve-wracking to put myself out there, but it was a blast. Plus, I picked up a few new recipes!

session_21.speaker: Julia
session_21.text: Way to go, Noah! Congrats on the cooking show, I'll definitely be tuning in! What's your favorite dish from the show?

session_21.speaker: Noah
session_21.text: Coconut milk ice cream is at the top of my list. It's so smooth and creamy with a tropical coconut twist. Plus, it's dairy-free for people who can't have lactose or who want vegan options. Here's a snap of the ice cream I made.

session_21.speaker: Julia
session_21.text: Wow, that looks amazing, Noah! I love the color and texture. It's great that you're making these options. Could you share the recipe? I'd love to try making it sometime!

session_21.speaker: Noah
session_21.text: Yeah sure! Would love to share it. Let's spread the joy of dairy-free options! Let me know when you make it!

session_21.speaker: Julia
session_21.text: Cool, Noah! Gonna give it a go. Dairy-free is a must for me, especially for desserts. Last Friday, I made a deeeelish dessert with almond milk - it was good! Got any favs when it comes to dairy-free desserts?

session_21.speaker: Noah
session_21.text: Coconut milk ice cream is one of my favorites as you might be able to tell, but I also love a dairy-free chocolate mousse. It's super creamy and tastes like the real thing. What's been your favorite dairy-free sweet treat so far?

session_21.speaker: Julia
session_21.text: Hey Noah, my favorite dairy-free treat is this amazing chocolate raspberry tart. It has an almond flour crust, chocolate ganache, and fresh raspberries - it's delicious!

session_21.speaker: Noah
session_21.text: That looks amazing, Julia! I need to try baking that. What other treats do you like making?

session_21.speaker: Julia
session_21.text: Hey Noah, I love making this dairy-free chocolate cake with raspberries. It's so moist and delicious - perfect sweetness level.

session_21.speaker: Noah
session_21.text: That cake looks amazing, Julia! How did you make it?

session_21.speaker: Julia
session_21.text: I make it with almond flour, coconut oil, chocolate and raspberries. It's my favorite for birthdays and special days.

session_21.speaker: Noah
session_21.text: Yum, Julia! Gotta try that one. Any others you want to share?

session_21.speaker: Julia
session_21.text: Hey Noah! Here's another recipe I like. It's a delicious dessert made with blueberries, coconut milk, and a gluten-free crust. So creamy and delicious!

session_21.speaker: Noah
session_21.text: Wow, Julia! That dessert looks amazing. I'll definitely have to give it a try. Thanks!

session_21.speaker: Julia
session_21.text: Glad to help, Noah. Let me know if you try it. I'm sure you'll enjoy it. It was great chatting.

session_21.speaker: Noah
session_21.text: Thanks Julia! I will. Bye!

session_22.speaker: Julia
session_22.text: Hey Noah, hi! Yesterday, I tried my newest dairy-free recipe and it was a winner with my family! Mixing and matching flavors is fun and I'm always trying new things. How about you?

session_22.speaker: Noah
session_22.text: Hey Julia! That tart looks yummy! Lately, I've been doing great - I won a really big video game tournament last week and it was awesome! I still can't believe I made so much money from it.

session_22.speaker: Julia
session_22.text: Way to go, Noah! Winning the tournament and earning cash is awesome - congrats! Did you save it for something special?

session_22.speaker: Noah
session_22.text: Thanks Julia! Yeah, I saved some but I'm not sure what to do with it - I'm completely content already. I don't have big plans anyway, so it's nice to have the extra cash on hand.

session_22.speaker: Julia
session_22.text: That's awesome, Noah! Having some extra cash on hand definitely brings a sense of freedom and relaxation, huh?

session_22.speaker: Noah
session_22.text: Yes! Finally, I don't have to stress about it, so I can just enjoy my movies and games.

session_22.speaker: Julia
session_22.text: Taking breaks and reducing stress is pretty nice! Have you watched any good movies recently? I could use some recommendations!

session_22.speaker: Noah
session_22.text: I watched "Little Women" recently, and it was great! The acting was awesome and the story was so captivating. Definitely a good one!

session_22.speaker: Julia
session_22.text: I'm so glad you enjoyed it! I recommended it to you a while back. I watched it too and it really spoke to me. Themes like sisterhood, love, and chasing dreams were explored so well. By the way, I finished up my writing for my book last week. Put in a ton of late nights and edits but finally got it done. I'm so proud of it! Can't wait to see what happens next.

session_22.speaker: Noah
session_22.text: Way to go! We both know it took some effort, but I'm sure it'll be great. Congrats on finishing it up!

session_22.speaker: Julia
session_22.text: Thanks Noah! Your words mean a lot. Dedication and late nights got me here, but it was worth it. Just like you with your recent tournament - hard work pays off. I appreciate your support throughout!

session_22.speaker: Noah
session_22.text: I'm always here for you, Julia! You've worked so hard and accomplished a lot – I'm proud. Keep on going!

session_22.speaker: Julia
session_22.text: Thanks, Noah! I won't give up on my goals as long as your here to support me.

session_22.speaker: Noah
session_22.text: You can always count on me! I even made this for you!

session_22.speaker: Julia
session_22.text: Wow, Noah, that looks awesome! What inspired you?

session_22.speaker: Noah
session_22.text: I figured you could always look back on this whenever you need encouragement, and that was all the inspiration I needed. And I would also say that your life path can be quite inspirational!

session_22.speaker: Julia
session_22.text: Wow, Noah! That's sweet of you! I'll make sure to remember this when I need the encouragement the most.

session_22.speaker: Noah
session_22.text: Awesome! I know encouragement is what got me so far in my gameing career, so I figured why not share the love.

session_22.speaker: Julia
session_22.text: Rest assured, it will be something I cherish! On another note, I just finished this cute little bookmark for one of the ladies at my writing club!

session_22.speaker: Noah
session_22.text: That bookmark is great. I'm sure she'll love it!

session_22.speaker: Julia
session_22.text: Thanks Noah! I absolutley love DIYs, and I know she does too.

session_22.speaker: Noah
session_22.text: Let me know how it goes!

session_22.speaker: Julia
session_22.text: Sure thing! Bye for now!

session_23.speaker: Noah
session_23.text: Hey Julia, it's been a couple days since we last talked. Something exciting happened last Friday. I went to a game convention and met new people who weren't from my normal circle. It was a bit overwhelming but it reminded me of the good times gaming can bring.

session_23.speaker: Julia
session_23.text: Hey Noah! Good to hear from you. Sounds like fun! Meeting new people can be overwhelming, but the rewards can be great. Sometimes it's good to step outside our comfort zones and explore new things.

session_23.speaker: Noah
session_23.text: Yeah, you're right! We can have great experiences if we take risks. I even made some friends at the convention who love games just like me. We already planned a gaming session together - it's cool to meet people who have the same interests!

session_23.speaker: Julia
session_23.text: That looks awesome! I'm glad you met people who share your interests - that definitely makes experiences more fun..

session_23.speaker: Noah
session_23.text: I also met some people who also played this boardgame I love, so I joined in. We had a lot in common and hit it off. It's great when shared hobbies can bond people!

session_23.speaker: Julia
session_23.text: It's incredible how a game can bring people together and form strong relationships. Did you do anything else there?

session_23.speaker: Noah
session_23.text: We played this game Catan - it's a great strategy game where you build settlements and trade resources. I love it!

session_23.speaker: Julia
session_23.text: Looks cool! Is it more of a competitive game or a more chill one?

session_23.speaker: Noah
session_23.text: It can be both competitive and chill. We were competing, but still had lots of fun.

session_23.speaker: Julia
session_23.text: Competitive games can definitely be difficult to play sometimes when people get all upset about every move you make, but it's cool they were all chill! Glad you had a good time.

session_23.speaker: Noah
session_23.text: It was great! Playing games is my escape from life struggles, so I generally don't get crazy competitive over them. The people at the convention were the same way!

session_23.speaker: Julia
session_23.text: Glad you found a way to have fun and escape! It's important to stay happy and de-stress. Keep doing what makes you happy!

session_23.speaker: Noah
session_23.text: For sure! You should go to a writing convention or something sometime! The experience at this convention is unforgetable.

session_23.speaker: Julia
session_23.text: Do writing conventions exist? I'll have to look into that, it could be fun! Thanks for the idea. Have you been up to anything tonight?

session_23.speaker: Noah
session_23.text: Mostly just chilling at home. Playing video games or watching movies helps me unwind.

session_23.speaker: Julia
session_23.text: That sounds great! What's your favorite game or movie that you've seen recently?

session_23.speaker: Noah
session_23.text: I recently saw a movie that blew my mind with all the twists and dream stuff, I think it was called "Inception". I've also been playing a game nonstop with a great futuristic setting and gameplay called "Cyberpunk 2077". Have you seen or played anything good lately?

session_23.speaker: Julia
session_23.text: I watched a classic movie the other day that was awesome - the story was so gripping and the actors were great! It really stuck with me.

session_23.speaker: Noah
session_23.text: Wow, that must have been awesome! What would you rate it?

session_23.speaker: Julia
session_23.text: Well, it was amazing, so probably 9 or 10 out of 10! Movies can take us to different places and make us feel lots of emotions. What do you love about watching them?

session_23.speaker: Noah
session_23.text: Well they take me to new worlds and fill me with emotions. Plus, they're great for chilling out after a day.

session_23.speaker: Julia
session_23.text: I agree! They have the power to take us away and make us feel things not normally experienced in life. It's a great escape! Especially when you have a room like this!

session_23.speaker: Noah
session_23.text: Wow, it's so comfy in there! I should really get a set up like that.

session_23.speaker: Julia
session_23.text: You should! It's one thing to watch a movie in a theater, but on a nice comfy couch with a good blanket, I feel so at peace!

session_23.speaker: Noah
session_23.text: Any pointers on what I should get for my living room to make it comfy like that?

session_23.speaker: Julia
session_23.text: Sure! For one, you should get a couch that can sit multiple people so that you can lay down if you want, and make sure its really fluffy! Also invest in a blanket that has a little bit of weight to it, and some lights that can be dimmed.

session_23.speaker: Noah
session_23.text: Sounds like you really got into making your living room! Thanks, I'll try that out for myself!

session_23.speaker: Julia
session_23.text: No problem! I get super invested in random little things like that, but I think its all worth it when I end up with random little things that make life so much nicer.

session_23.speaker: Noah
session_23.text: Thanks for the tip! See you later!

session_23.speaker: Julia
session_23.text: See ya Noah!

session_24.speaker: Noah
session_24.text: Hey Julia, what's been up? Haven't seen you since we last talked.

session_24.speaker: Julia
session_24.text: Hey Noah! I have been revising and perfecting the recipe I made for my family and it turned out really tasty. What's been happening with you?

session_24.speaker: Noah
session_24.text: Hey Julia! That's cool. I've been getting so stressed lately because of my tournament progress - tough competitors - but my turtles always cheer me up.

session_24.speaker: Julia
session_24.text: Pets have a way of brightening our days. I still have that stuffed animal dog you gave me! I named her Tilly, and she's always with me while I write.

session_24.speaker: Noah
session_24.text: Glad to hear it! What made you name her Tilly?

session_24.speaker: Julia
session_24.text: I used to have a dog back in Michigan with that name, but then I got allergic and we had to get rid of her. The name helps me remember her back when I used to be able to hold and squeeze animal without an allergic reaction!

session_24.speaker: Noah
session_24.text: That's so touching! Glad the stuffed animal means so much!

session_24.speaker: Julia
session_24.text: Tilly helps me stay focused and brings me so much joy. It's amazing how even stuffed animals can do that!

session_24.speaker: Noah
session_24.text: It really is, I'm not sure I'll ever understand why watching my turtles slowly walk around makes me so happy. But I'm very glad it does.

session_24.speaker: Julia
session_24.text: Same here! So have you been up to anything recenly?

session_24.speaker: Noah
session_24.text: Yeah, I've just been practicing for my next video game tournemant. How about you?

session_24.speaker: Julia
session_24.text: Well, I had a bit of a setback recently - another rejection from a production company.

session_24.speaker: Noah
session_24.text: Bummer, Julia. Is this the one you sent to a film contest? Rejections suck, but don't forget they don't define you. Keep at it and you'll find the perfect opportunity.

session_24.speaker: Julia
session_24.text: Yeah.. Thanks, Noah. It's hard, but I won't let it slow me down. I'm gonna keep grinding and moving ahead.

session_24.speaker: Noah
session_24.text: That's what I like to hear! I really respect you for that and being able to bounce back whenever something sad happens!

session_24.speaker: Julia
session_24.text: Thanks, Noah! Your encouragement really means a lot. I'm gonna keep pushing forward and believing in myself.

session_24.speaker: Noah
session_24.text: You got this, and don't ever forget that you have people cheering you on from the sidelines wherever you go.

session_24.speaker: Julia
session_24.text: Thanks! I'll see you around!

session_24.speaker: Noah
session_24.text: No problem! Catch you later!

session_25.speaker: Noah
session_25.text: Hey Julia, what's been up since we last chatted? How's it going?

session_25.speaker: Julia
session_25.text: Hey Noah! Another movie script that I contributed to was shown on the big screen last Sunday for the first time! It was such a surreal experience to see everything come together. I felt a mix of emotions, but overall, it was a satisfying moment. I've been waiting for this for a long time!

session_25.speaker: Noah
session_25.text:
Congrats Julia! How was it to finally see it on the big screen?

[shares a photo holding a videogame controller]

session_25.speaker: Julia
session_25.text: It was an amazing experience! I'll never forget seeing all of the characters and dialogue I wrote being acted out - it was such a cool feeling. Having all the hard work and determination I put into writing pay off was definitely rewarding. I know this is the third time it's happened, but its just so awesome!

session_25.speaker: Noah
session_25.text: That must have been amazing. What was your favorite part of it?

session_25.speaker: Julia
session_25.text: Seeing my characters I worked so hard on come alive was my favorite part. It felt like they jumped off the page and became real - it was totally surreal.

session_25.speaker: Noah
session_25.text: Wow Julia, those drawings are really incredible! What inspired you to create them?

session_25.speaker: Julia
session_25.text: Thanks, Noah! They're visuals of the characters to help bring them alive in my head so I can write better.

session_25.speaker: Noah
session_25.text: That's a cool way to gain insight into your characters. Where did you get your ideas for them?

session_25.speaker: Julia
session_25.text: I got ideas from everywhere: people I know, stuff I saw, even what I imagined. It's cool to see how an idea takes shape into a person with their own wants, worries, and wishes.

session_25.speaker: Noah
session_25.text: Wow Julia, that's so cool! It's amazing how our imaginations can bring ideas to life. Can you tell me more about the character on the left in the photo?

session_25.speaker: Julia
session_25.text: Nope! You'll just have to watch the movie and find out for yourself!

session_25.speaker: Noah
session_25.text: You got it. I was already planning on watching it, but talking to you about it makes me want to watch it even more!

session_25.speaker: Julia
session_25.text: Awesome! Well enough about me, what have you been up to?

session_25.speaker: Noah
session_25.text: I was bored today, so I just took my turtles out for a walk.

session_25.speaker: Julia
session_25.text: Sound fun! Did they have a good time?

session_25.speaker: Noah
session_25.text: Of course! They look tired from all the walking, so they're relaxing in the tank right now.

session_25.speaker: Julia
session_25.text: Aww, they're so cute! What do they eat?

session_25.speaker: Noah
session_25.text: They eat a combination of vegetables, fruits, and insects. They have a varied diet.

session_25.speaker: Julia
session_25.text: Wow, that's fascinating! It's interesting how they have such a varied diet, including insects. Do you have a favorite among their food choices?

session_25.speaker: Noah
session_25.text: I love seeing them eat fruit - they get so hyped and it's so cute!

session_25.speaker: Julia
session_25.text: Wow, that's so cute! They look like they really enjoy fruit.

session_25.speaker: Noah
session_25.text: Yeah, it's adorable! Watching them enjoy their favorite snacks is so fun. I also like holding them.

session_25.speaker: Julia
session_25.text: Do they have different personalities, like the way dogs and cats do?

session_25.speaker: Noah
session_25.text: Yeah, they each do. One is more adventurous while the other is more reserved, which I find cute. Having them around brings me joy and they make great companions.

session_25.speaker: Julia
session_25.text: That's super cool! I never knew turtles could be so interesting until I met your turtles. Wow!

session_25.speaker: Noah
session_25.text: I've always liked turtles since I was a boy, so I know all about them!

session_25.speaker: Julia
session_25.text: You'll have to keep me posted on them! It's been fun chatting!

session_25.speaker: Noah
session_25.text: See you later Julia!

session_26.speaker: Julia
session_26.text: Wow, Noah, I'm on fire! I just set up meetings with movie producers — my dreams are comin' true!

session_26.speaker: Noah
session_26.text: Wow Julia, nice work! How did it go with those producer meetings?

session_26.speaker: Julia
session_26.text: Thanks, Noah! The meetings went really well. I felt confident discussing my script and vision and they seemed interested and excited. They loved the elements of self-discovery in it. It was so validating to be taken seriously. I'm feeling hopeful and inspired about the future!

session_26.speaker: Noah
session_26.text: Way to go, Julia! Putting yourself out there is really brave and winning recognition for your hard work feels great. It's just like when I win a video game tournament - it feels awesome! I'm so proud of you and so glad you're feeling hopeful and inspired.

session_26.speaker: Julia
session_26.text: Thanks Noah! Your support and encouragement mean a lot. Writing isn't always easy but moments like these make me appreciate it. I'm so thankful for all the opportunities. Last week, I found these old notebooks with my early writings - it was cool to see how far I've come.

session_26.speaker: Noah
session_26.text: That's cool! You must love seeing how you've grown as an artist. Is there a favorite piece from your early writings that stands out to you?

session_26.speaker: Julia
session_26.text: Yup, I still remember this story from when I was 10. It was about a brave little turtle who was scared but explored the world anyway. Maybe even back then, I was inspired by stories about finding courage and taking risks. It's still a part of my writing today.

session_26.speaker: Noah
session_26.text: You obviously have a passion for writing, and it's funny the story was about a turtle! Their resilience is so inspiring! Take courage and keep pushing yourself with your writing. Great job!

session_26.speaker: Julia
session_26.text: Thanks, Noah! They make me think of strength and perseverance. They help motivate me in tough times - glad you find that inspiring!

session_26.speaker: Noah
session_26.text: What can I say, I love turtles. So, what's been happening with you?

session_26.speaker: Julia
session_26.text: Hey Noah! Apart from meetings, I'm working on a project - challenging but fulfilling. How about you? What's been going on?

session_26.speaker: Noah
session_26.text: Just been helping some friends reset their high scores at the international tournament. It's been fun!

session_26.speaker: Julia
session_26.text: Wow, sounds like so much fun! You're really passionate about gaming. Have an awesome time and keep helping others with those high scores!

session_26.speaker: Noah
session_26.text: Thanks! It feels good to use my skills to make a difference.

session_26.speaker: Julia
session_26.text: I couldn't agree more! Which is why my meetings are so exciting!

session_26.speaker: Noah
session_26.text: On another note, want to come over and try some of this? It's super yummy, just made it yesterday!

session_26.speaker: Julia
session_26.text: Mmm, that looks delicious! Is it lactose-free by any chance?

session_26.speaker: Noah
session_26.text: Yep, I made it with coconut milk so it's lactose-free!

session_26.speaker: Julia
session_26.text: Thanks so much, Noah! Sure! I'll come over tomorrow if that's fine.

session_26.speaker: Noah
session_26.text: I don't see why not! I'm not doing anything then, so your completely welcome to!

session_26.speaker: Julia
session_26.text: Awesome! I'll bring some of my recipes so we can both share deserts!

session_26.speaker: Noah
session_26.text: I'd love that! I've been wanting to try some of your chocolate and rasberry cake for a while now.

session_26.speaker: Julia
session_26.text: You got it! See you tomorrow!

session_26.speaker: Noah
session_26.text: See you then! Take care!

session_27.speaker: Noah
session_27.text: Hey Julia! Hope you’re doing alright. Crazy thing happened - I was in the final of a big Overwatch tournament last Saturday, and I won! It was the best feeling to see my name as the champion. Tournaments really bring out strong emotions in me.

session_27.speaker: Julia
session_27.text: Hey Noah! Congrats on winning the tournament - that's awesome! I know you must have been buzzing! Anyway, I've been working on something exciting too. Last Friday, I finished the presentation for producers - it was tough but it's looking good. What have you been up to?

session_27.speaker: Noah
session_27.text: Thanks, Julia! I've been having a blast and preparing for other tournaments, so I've been real busy - but I'm loving it!

session_27.speaker: Julia
session_27.text: Sounds like you're really loving life right now! It's great when you find something that suits you. Being busy can be tiring but it's so rewarding in the end. Keep it up!

session_27.speaker: Noah
session_27.text: Thanks, Julia! I'm really grateful to have a job I enjoy every day. So anyways, anything new going on in your life?

session_27.speaker: Julia
session_27.text: I am writing another movie script! It's a love story with lots of challenges. I've put lots of hard work into it and I'm hoping to get it on the big screen.

session_27.speaker: Noah
session_27.text: Woah Julia, that's incredible! I remember when you started working on these sorta things. It's crazy to see how far you've gotten! You've really got a thing for writing, huh? Where'd you get the idea for it?

session_27.speaker: Julia
session_27.text: Thanks Noah! Writing has always been a passion of mine. I got the idea for this script from a dream. How have your turtles been? I haven't seen pictures of them in a while!

session_27.speaker: Noah
session_27.text: Great actually! These little guys sure bring joy to my life! Watching them is so calming and fascinating. I've really grown fond of them. So, what about you, Julia? What brings you happiness?

session_27.speaker: Julia
session_27.text: Creating stories and watching them come alive gives me happiness and fulfillment. Writing has been such a blessing for me.

session_27.speaker: Noah
session_27.text: Well with dedication like yours, its no wonder you do so well in it as well! Are you planning on submitting anymore scripts anytime soon?

session_27.speaker: Julia
session_27.text: Yep! I actually just submitted a few more last week! Hoping to hear back from them soon, though I assume a few will be rejected.

session_27.speaker: Noah
session_27.text: Even if it happens to a few, I'm sure at leasts one will make it to the screens and be your 3rd published movie!

session_27.speaker: Julia
session_27.text: Thanks, Noah! Appreciate the encouragement. I won't give up, I promise! Got it covered!

session_27.speaker: Noah
session_27.text: Great to hear! On another note, I just upgraded some of my equipment at home. Check it out!

session_27.speaker: Julia
session_27.text: Oh wow, ice set-up! Do you use that computer for gaming?

session_27.speaker: Noah
session_27.text: Yep! This is where I practice and compete. Sometimes I even use it when I'm playing games with friends.

session_27.speaker: Julia
session_27.text: Cool! Having a dedicated space for practice and competition should help you stay focused.

session_27.speaker: Noah
session_27.text: Yeah, I love it. It's like my own little haven to escape into the virtual world.

session_27.speaker: Julia
session_27.text: Wow, that sounds great to have your own gaming setup at home. It must be really awesome!

session_27.speaker: Noah
session_27.text: It really is! But it's also really important to have something like this for my career, otherwise I would never be able to beat my competition.

session_27.speaker: Julia
session_27.text: That makes sense! It's all about practice isn't it? So what's your favorite game?

session_27.speaker: Noah
session_27.text: Yep! I'm currently playing this awesome fantasy RPG called "Xeonoblade Chronicles" and it's been a blast! I highly reccomend it if you've never played it before.

session_27.speaker: Julia
session_27.text: What made you start playing it? That's a japanese game series right?

session_27.speaker: Noah
session_27.text: Yes it is! I'm a big fan of Nintendo games, and I've actually been wanting to play this one for a while because my friends have played it and reccomended it!

session_27.speaker: Julia
session_27.text: Nice! It's really cool when a reccomendation from a friend fits your taste so well isn't it?

session_27.speaker: Noah
session_27.text: For sure! That's why I love when you give me movie reccomendations, I usually like them a lot more then if I were to just watch some random one.

session_27.speaker: Julia
session_27.text: Great to hear! I just finished with the intro to my next movie script, and I decided to include this at the begining.

session_27.speaker: Noah
session_27.text: That letter is really awesome! Does it remind you of your childhood?

session_27.speaker: Julia
session_27.text: Yeah, it does! My brother wrote it - he used to make me these cute notes when we were kids. Brings back sweet memories.

session_27.speaker: Noah
session_27.text: Aww, childhood memories can be so powerful!

session_27.speaker: Julia
session_27.text: They sure can! They take us back to simpler times but it's nice to create new memories as we grow up.

session_27.speaker: Noah
session_27.text: Totally! I had a special day when I took my pets to the park. They were amazed and seeing their happy faces made it a memorable day. Mixing the new with the old is priceless - I treasure every memory!

session_27.speaker: Julia
session_27.text: That sounds so sweet, Noah! I started writing some of my favorite memories down.

session_27.speaker: Noah
session_27.text: Dang, your full of great ideas Julia! I really should start doing that as well, or at least write down the things my animals like a lot!

session_27.speaker: Julia
session_27.text: You should! I completely encourage it, looking back on fond memories is such a blessing.

session_27.speaker: Noah
session_27.text: Ok I will! But I'll also start writing down some of my favorite memories with you from now on.

session_27.speaker: Julia
session_27.text: Definitely, let's keep making great memories and supporting each other. Let's keep reaching for our dreams and make them happen!

session_28.speaker: Noah
session_28.text: Hey Julia, what a wild week! My game tournament got pushed back, so I tried out some cooking. Look at this homemade coconut ice cream! The sprinkles kinda changed the color this time around.

session_28.speaker: Julia
session_28.text: Hey Noah, that looks yummy! Wish I could try it, but I can't right now. How did the last game tournament go?

session_28.speaker: Noah
session_28.text: Hey Julia, thanks! Tough tournament, didn't make it to the finals. But that's okay, I'll get 'em next time!

session_28.speaker: Julia
session_28.text: Aww, bummer! But the important thing is to stay positive. So, what's your next move in the gaming world?

session_28.speaker: Noah
session_28.text: Thanks Julia! Staying positive is key. I'm thinking of joining a new gaming team after this next tourney - I've had a few offers, but I haven't decided yet. It's gonna be a big step, but I'm ready for a shake up.

session_28.speaker: Julia
session_28.text: Sounds great, Noah! Making a switch could open up new opportunities. Wishing you luck with picking the right team!

session_28.speaker: Noah
session_28.text: Thanks, Julia! I really appreciate it. It's a big decision, but I'm excited for what the future holds. How about you? Anything exciting happening on your end?

session_28.speaker: Julia
session_28.text: Yup! I worked hard on another script and eventually created a plan for getting it made into a movie. It was a ton of work but satisfying. I pitched it to some producers yesterday and they really liked it. It gave me a big confidence boost!

session_28.speaker: Noah
session_28.text: Congrats on the chance to pitch your script - super impressive. Proud of you!

session_28.speaker: Julia
session_28.text: Appreciate you, Noah! Your support and encouragement mean a lot to me. I feel like I just can't stop writing write now!

session_28.speaker: Noah
session_28.text: Anytime. What're you working on in that notebook? Anything cool?

session_28.speaker: Julia
session_28.text: Hey Noah, I'm working on a new project - a suspenseful thriller set in a small Midwestern town. It's been a great creative outlet for me. How about you? Do you have any projects you're working on?

session_28.speaker: Noah
session_28.text: Yeah actually - creating gaming content for YouTube. It's a cool way to entertain folks and satisfy my video game cravings at the same time when there aren't any tourneys going on.

session_28.speaker: Julia
session_28.text: Wow, that's a cool idea! What inspired you to start making gaming videos?

session_28.speaker: Noah
session_28.text: Hey Julia, I'm a big fan of them and thought it would be a fun idea to start making them myself. I'm hoping to share my love of gaming and connect with others who enjoy it too.

session_28.speaker: Julia
session_28.text: Way to go, Noah! Making videos and connecting with people about gaming - that's awesome! You'll do great!

session_28.speaker: Noah
session_28.text: Thanks Julia! Appreciate the support. It's new to me but I'm excited to get started!

session_28.speaker: Julia
session_28.text: Make sure you watch other peoples videos first so you get a handle on what your audience likes! That way your videos don't flop when you post them.

session_28.speaker: Noah
session_28.text: Already doing that, but thanks for the advice!

session_28.speaker: Julia
session_28.text: No worries, Noah! It's great to support each other in reaching our goals. On another note, check out this pic I got a while back!

session_28.speaker: Noah
session_28.text: Wow, that sunset pic looks incredible! What inspired you to take that photo?

session_28.speaker: Julia
session_28.text: Thanks, Noah! I took that pic on a hike last summer near Fort Wayne. The sunset and the surrounding beauty were just incredible. It was an awesome reminder of nature's beauty.

session_28.speaker: Noah
session_28.text: That sounds incredible! Nature truly has a way of reminding us to appreciate the beauty around us, and moments like those really stay with you. These critters also make me appreciate life's little joys. And guess what? I got them a new friend!

session_28.speaker: Julia
session_28.text: Wow, what made you get a third?

session_28.speaker: Noah
session_28.text: Turtles really bring me joy and peace. They have such an effect on us - best buddies ever! I saw another at a pet store and just hade to get him. The tank is big enough now for three, so I figured why not!

session_28.speaker: Julia
session_28.text: Wow! It's always a shock where life will take us next! I bet just last week you would have never thought you would be getting a third turtle this year!

session_28.speaker: Noah
session_28.text: You got that right, but I'm very happy with the descision and wouldn't have it any other way.

session_28.speaker: Julia
session_28.text: Can I come over sometime and watch you play with them? From a distance I mean, since I'm allergic.

session_28.speaker: Noah
session_28.text: Definitely! I'd love to have you over again. Maybe we can watch one of your movies together or go to the park!

session_28.speaker: Julia
session_28.text: For sure! I'd love to do either of those things with you!

session_28.speaker: Noah
session_28.text: Sounds good. Well I'll make sure I give the turtles a bath before you get here so they're ready to play.

session_28.speaker: Julia
session_28.text: Alright, see you tomorrow!

session_28.speaker: Noah
session_28.text: Bye Julia!

session_29.speaker: Julia
session_29.text: Noah, can you believe it? I'm finally filming my own movie from the road-trip script!

session_29.speaker: Noah
session_29.text: Congrats, Julia! Not surprised at all that your hard work paid off. Must feel awesome to see your script come alive in a movie! Pretty cool when something you love brings success, right? Tell me more about your movie!

session_29.speaker: Julia
session_29.text: Woohoo, thanks Noah! It's pretty wild to see it come alive. Every day on set is awesome and full of potential. Being able to show my vision is awesome.

session_29.speaker: Noah
session_29.text: I think so too! What's been the coolest moment on set?

session_29.speaker: Julia
session_29.text: One of the actors came up to me and told me how much she liked my script! I was so excited when that happened - it gave me chills!

session_29.speaker: Noah
session_29.text: Wow Julia, that must have been so exciting! It's incredible when you get those moments of joy. Anyway, I took my turtles to the beach in Tampa yesterday! They always bring me peace in the craziness of life.

session_29.speaker: Julia
session_29.text: Woah, that's awesome, Noah! You must really enjoy having them around - they're so cool! What do you love most about having them?

session_29.speaker: Noah
session_29.text: Your completely right! I really love having them around. They're so cool and they make me feel calm. Plus, they don't require much looking after, which is great. I love seeing them soaking in the sun like this.

session_29.speaker: Julia
session_29.text: That's awesome, Noah! They look so serene and happy. It's great to have something like that.

session_29.speaker: Noah
session_29.text: Yeah, turtles are like zen masters! They always remind me to slow down and appreciate the small things in life. I'm loving experimenting with flavors right now. Here are some colorful bowls of coconut milk ice cream that I made.

session_29.speaker: Julia
session_29.text: Hey Noah, that looks really yummy! The colors and mix-ins give it a nice kick.

session_29.speaker: Noah
session_29.text: Nice! I'm glad you like it too. This recipe really jazzes it up. Wanna give it a try?

session_29.speaker: Julia
session_29.text: Definitely, Noah! That ice cream looks mouthwatering. Thanks so much for offering!

session_29.speaker: Noah
session_29.text: No worries, Julia. Hope you enjoy it!

session_29.speaker: Julia
session_29.text: Yea, no worries! It was great catching up. Take it easy!
