session_6.text: Hey Seth, long time no talk! Hope you're doing great. I just got back from a rad vacay with my new SO in Canada. Tried some awesome activities too - think hiking, biking... all that cool stuff. We loved exploring the outdoors together, it was so awesome!

session_6.speaker: Seth
session_6.text: Hey Ethan! Good to hear from you. Wow, Canada sounds amazing! That photo looks stunning. Wish I could do something like that. Things have been a bit challenging for me lately; some stuff has been hard on my health.

session_6.speaker: Ethan
session_6.text: Sorry to hear that things haven't been going well. Dealing with health issues can be tough. Is there anything I can do to help?

session_6.speaker: Seth
session_6.text: Thanks, Ethan. Your support means a lot to me. It's tough staying positive, but knowing I have people like you in my corner makes it easier.

session_6.speaker: Ethan
session_6.text: Glad to support you, Seth. Surrounding ourselves with people who care is key. What's on that note? A reminder or quote to stay motivated?

session_6.speaker: Seth
session_6.text: Yeah, it's actually a quote that's been helping me stay motivated. It reminds me that progress is more important than perfection. Taking small steps towards a healthier life is still progress.

session_6.speaker: Ethan
session_6.text: Cool mindset, Seth! I totally agree, progress over perfection. Mind sharing the quote with me? I would love to get something out of it too.

session_6.speaker: Seth
session_6.text: "Don't fear it, just take the first step. It's been helping me move forward to healthier habits!"

session_6.speaker: Ethan
session_6.text: Love the quote, Seth. That mindset really helps me too. Thanks!

session_6.speaker: Seth
session_6.text: You're welcome! Glad it helps. These times can be challenging.

session_6.speaker: Ethan
session_6.text: They can be tough, but remember to celebrate the small wins - every step forward counts!

session_6.speaker: Seth
session_6.text: You're absolutely right! Celebrating those small wins is crucial. It's easy to get caught up in the challenges and setbacks, but those little victories are what keep me motivated. Thanks for the reminder, it's much appreciated.

session_6.speaker: Ethan
session_6.text: Absolutely, Seth. Remember, every small victory is a step forward, so keep up the good work! I'm cheering for you! And hey, I could use some cheering too - I've been searching for my keys for the last half hour with no luck! I'm losing it every week..

session_6.speaker: Seth
session_6.text: Oh, I'll definitely be your cheerleader once I get some sleep, Ethan! Funny you mention that, I had this amazing dream last night where I was soaring over skyscrapers. It felt incredible! Makes me wonder what it signifies...

session_6.speaker: Ethan
session_6.text: That does sound like an amazing dream! Maybe you should check out a dream interpretation book; it could offer some insights. Sweet dreams, Seth!

session_6.speaker: Seth
session_6.text: Thanks for the suggestion, Ethan. I'll look into it. This journey feels endless at times, but I'm convinced it's going to be rewarding in the end. So good luck with your keys, Ethan!

session_6.speaker: Ethan
session_6.text: I'll just keep going, step by step, and I'll definitely find those keys!

session_6.speaker: Seth
session_6.text: That's for sure!

session_6.speaker: Ethan
session_6.text: Go to bed already, bud! And take care!

session_7.speaker: Ethan
session_7.text: Hey Seth, what's up? It's been a few days since we talked. How have you been? Life's been tough lately - my son had a soccer accident last Saturday and hurt his ankle, it was tough seeing him hurt! I just been looking after him and taking him to the doctor. As a dad, it's hard to watch your kid go through something like that.

session_7.speaker: Seth
session_7.text: Hey Ethan, sorry to hear about what happened. I can imagine how hard it must have been for you. Things haven't been easy for me either. Had a tough week and a doc's appointment, so it was kinda like a wake-up call to take better care of myself. On a bright side, I'm taking a cooking class to learn how to make healthier meals.

session_7.speaker: Ethan
session_7.text: Hey Seth, sorry to hear you had a rough week. At least it's forcing us both to take better care of ourselves, right? I hear the class you're taking is packed with healthy recipes. How's it been going? Have you picked up any yummy new meals?

session_7.speaker: Seth
session_7.text: The cooking class has been great, I've learned awesome recipes. Last night I made this yummy grilled dish, so good!

session_7.speaker: Ethan
session_7.text: Mmm, it looks delicious! What did you put in it? I want to eat healthy, so what kind of recipes do you suggest?

session_7.speaker: Seth
session_7.text: Thanks, Ethan! I marinated it with a few different ingredients and grilled it with some veggies. It turned out really flavorful! If you want, I can share more recipes from my cooking class. Just let me know what you're looking for!

session_7.speaker: Ethan
session_7.text: That'd be great, Seth! I'm looking to add more vegetables to my meals. Do you have any recipes for that?

session_7.speaker: Seth
session_7.text: Yeah definitely, Ethan. I have a tasty and easy roasted veg recipe that I can share with you. Oh, by the way, how have you been doing after the soccer incident? Must've been tough.

session_7.speaker: Ethan
session_7.text: Thanks, Seth. His ankle is getting better, but still sore. It was rough at first, but thank goodness it was nothing serious.

session_7.speaker: Seth
session_7.text: Glad to hear his ankle is getting better. It's hard seeing someone we care about hurt. Look after yourself too, yeah? We gotta look after our health.

session_7.speaker: Ethan
session_7.text: Yep, taking care of ourselves is a must. How have you been feeling lately?

session_7.speaker: Seth
session_7.text: I have been feeling a mix of emotions - somewhat concerned about my health but also motivated to make positive changes. Taking things one step at a time.

session_7.speaker: Ethan
session_7.text: It's okay to feel overwhelmed, Seth. Just keep moving forward slowly and taking small steps. You're doing awesome.

session_7.speaker: Seth
session_7.text: Thanks, Ethan, your encouragement means a lot to me. I'll keep going and take it one step at a time!

session_7.speaker: Ethan
session_7.text: No worries, just keep going and taking it one step at a time! You'll get there.

session_7.speaker: Seth
session_7.text: Thanks, Ethan. I really appreciate that. It means a lot.

session_8.speaker: Seth
session_8.text: Hey Ethan, some big news: I'm on a diet and living healthier! Been tough, but I'm determined.

session_8.speaker: Ethan
session_8.text: Wow, Seth, that's great news! Making changes to live healthier can be challenging, how has it been going?

session_8.speaker: Seth
session_8.text: It's tough, but I'm sticking with it.

session_8.speaker: Ethan
session_8.text: Nice work, Seth! Proud of you sticking to it. Have you noticed any positive changes?

session_8.speaker: Seth
session_8.text: Yes, there are many, such as more energy and less sluggishness after eating. This is really encouraging!

session_8.speaker: Ethan
session_8.text: Wow, Seth, that's great to hear! Feeling more energized after meals is such a positive change. Keep up the good work! And speaking of healthy meals, do you have any favorite recipes you'd like to share?

session_8.speaker: Seth
session_8.text: Sure, I'm loving this recipe I found. It's a flavorful and healthy grilled chicken and veggie stir-fry. Wanna give it a go?

session_8.speaker: Ethan
session_8.text: Mmm, looks yummy! Is the sauce a family secret? I'm always down to try new recipes!

session_8.speaker: Seth
session_8.text: Nah, it's just my homemade sauce. Want the recipe?

session_8.speaker: Ethan
session_8.text: Yeah, I'd love to! Thanks for sharing the recipe.

session_8.speaker: Seth
session_8.text: Sure thing! Here's the recipe. Let me know how it went!

session_8.speaker: Ethan
session_8.text: Thanks Seth! I'll give it a shot and let you know how it went. Trying out new recipes is a great way to stay busy and creative. By the way, I also started taking a painting classes few days ago and I'm really enjoying it. It's all about trying new things, right?

session_8.speaker: Seth
session_8.text: You're already good at drawing, why did you decide to join a class? And why did you start painting then years ago anyway?

session_8.speaker: Ethan
session_8.text: Thanks, Seth! It all started when a friend of mine gave me this painting one day, it inspired me a lot and that's when I started painting. And I joined the classes to find like-minded people and show them what I can do, you can always improve your skills.

session_8.speaker: Seth
session_8.text: Wow, that's awesome! You're really talented. Did you take any other classes?

session_8.speaker: Ethan
session_8.text: Thanks, Seth! Just been painting with these for now, but might look into other classes. It's awesome for finding my peace and expressing myself!

session_8.speaker: Seth
session_8.text: Cool, Ethan! What have you been learning in those classes?

session_8.speaker: Ethan
session_8.text: In painting classes, we've been learning about watercolors. The instructor stresses observing nature and painting what we see. It's a relaxing way to take a break from everyday stress.

session_8.speaker: Seth
session_8.text: Wow, Ethan! What type of nature do you enjoy painting the most?

session_8.speaker: Ethan
session_8.text: I love painting landscapes. Nature's beauty captivates me and brings me peace. Here's one of my recent works.

session_8.speaker: Seth
session_8.text: Wow, Ethan! The colors are so bright. How do you capture the tranquil beauty of nature in your paintings?

session_8.speaker: Ethan
session_8.text: Thanks Seth! I aim to capture the vibe of nature in my paintings, conveying the peacefulness of being outdoors.

session_8.speaker: Seth
session_8.text: Wow, that pic is great! Do you often spend time in places like this?

session_8.speaker: Ethan
session_8.text: Thanks! I love being in places like this - it brings back memories of road tripping in my trusty car.

session_8.speaker: Seth
session_8.text: Wow, that's cool! Have you been to any fun places in that ride?

session_8.speaker: Ethan
session_8.text: Yep, last month I drove somewhere fun. The views were amazing!

session_8.speaker: Seth
session_8.text: Did you take advantage of the skiing opportunities in Banff? Sounds like it would have been a lot of fun!

session_8.speaker: Ethan
session_8.text: Yeah, it was great for skiing! The snow was amazing and I had a lot of fun. Can't wait to go back next year! Did you try any winter sports, Seth?

session_8.speaker: Seth
session_8.text: Ooh, skiing looks like a blast! I'd love to try it but I'm not sure my body can take it. What about you? What winter activities do you enjoy?

session_8.speaker: Ethan
session_8.text: Skiing, snowboarding, and ice skating are all fun winter activities I enjoy.

session_8.speaker: Seth
session_8.text: Wish I could join in on the fun! It sounds awesome.

session_8.speaker: Ethan
session_8.text: I'd like you to join me, too. Winter activities are a blast - hopefully someday you will!

session_8.speaker: Seth
session_8.text: Yeah, maybe. It's hard with that, you know. But who knows? Thanks for the understanding, Ethan - it really means a lot.

session_9.speaker: Seth
session_9.text: Hey Ethan! Exciting news: I started a new diet and exercise routine last Monday and it's made a huge difference. I feel great! What about you, what changes have you made recently?

session_9.speaker: Ethan
session_9.text: Wow, Seth, great! Glad your new diet/exercise is going well. As for me, I've hit a sore spot lately. Twisted my knee last Friday and it's really painful, so it's been tough to stay consistent with my usual fitness routine. It's really frustrating because staying active is like, mega-important to me.

session_9.speaker: Seth
session_9.text: Oh no, sorry to hear about that, Ethan. It's frustrating when our bodies don't cooperate, isn't it? Is there anything I can do to help?

session_9.speaker: Ethan
session_9.text: Thanks, Seth. I appreciate the concern. Life throws us curveballs - that's life, right? By the way, remember that book I was talking about? It just gets better with every page, can't let it out of my hands!

session_9.speaker: Seth
session_9.text: Life sure can be unpredictable and tough. Being adaptable and finding other ways to stay active is key when you're facing an obstacle. Maybe look into low-impact exercises or physical therapy to help with that? And damn, you really got me interested in this book haha!

session_9.speaker: Ethan
session_9.text: Yeah, PT for my knee is on the cards. Hopefully I'll get an appointment soon. Till then, just keeping it low-key and swimming to stay active.

session_9.speaker: Seth
session_9.text: Swimming is a good choice, Ethan. It's low-impact and easy on the joints, plus it's refreshing. Keep up with the active lifestyle!

session_9.speaker: Ethan
session_9.text: Yeah, thanks for the push, Seth. Oh, hey, I came across this pic when I was tidying up. I took a road trip last month - the scenery was stunning and nature really chilled me out.

session_9.speaker: Seth
session_9.text: Wow, looks great! Where did you go? Bet it was nice to get away.

session_9.speaker: Ethan
session_9.text: Thanks! I went up to the Rocky Mountains, it was so refreshing! The views were stunning and I felt so relaxed. Do you enjoy road trips and exploring nature?

session_9.speaker: Seth
session_9.text: I haven't gone on a road trip in ages, but I love being surrounded by nature. It's so tranquil and refreshing. I'd love to go hiking more, but it can be a bit challenging sometimes. However, I am working on becoming healthier, so maybe a road trip and a hike will be possible soon.

session_9.speaker: Ethan
session_9.text: That's cool, Seth. Nature can be really peaceful. I'd suggest going for more hikes, like I do. It's always been calming and fun. We should definitely do one together sometime.

session_9.speaker: Seth
session_9.text: Sounds like fun! Which lake do you recommend? I'd love to explore some of the local trails.

session_9.speaker: Ethan
session_9.text: Check out this one! It's gorgeous and there are lots of trails nearby. You'll love it!

session_9.speaker: Seth
session_9.text: Wow, it looks great! Is it nearby? What a view!

session_9.speaker: Ethan
session_9.text: It's only a two-hour drive from here, but trust me, it's worth every minute for the incredible views and peaceful atmosphere.

session_9.speaker: Seth
session_9.text: Cool, a day trip's doable. Nature's calling me, so I'm gonna go check it out! Thanks!

session_9.speaker: Ethan
session_9.text: No worries, enjoy your time in nature. Take care! Bye!

session_9.speaker: Seth
session_9.text: Thanks Ethan. Have a good one. See ya!

session_10.speaker: Ethan
session_10.text: Hey Seth! Long time no talk! Hope all is good. What have I been doing these past few weeks?

session_10.speaker: Seth
session_10.text: Hey Ethan! Nice to hear from you. Life has been an up and down ride. Have you seen the pic I posted of my before and after body as a result of the diet? Working to motivate others to make better choices.

session_10.speaker: Ethan
session_10.text: Hey Seth! Loving it. Making healthier choices has definitely made a difference for me. It's amazing how small changes can have such a big impact. How about you? Is it making a difference for you too?

session_10.speaker: Seth
session_10.text: Hey Ethan, thanks for the support! Handling all this has been kinda wild. I'm trying to make healthier choices, but there are still the occasional cravings for sugary drinks and snacks... it's a real struggle.

session_10.speaker: Ethan
session_10.text: Yeah, breaking bad habits can be hard. Cravings can be tough too, but little victories count. What do you think sets off those cravings for you?

session_10.speaker: Seth
session_10.text: It's usually stress, boredom, or just wanting comfort. You know, those sugary treats are so tempting, right?

session_10.speaker: Ethan
session_10.text: Yeah, I get it. When I'm stressed, I always turn to something comforting. But I've found that painting or going for a drive helps too!

session_10.speaker: Seth
session_10.text: Wow Ethan, that's an awesome painting! Good on you for finding a way to de-stress. I could really use something like that - maybe I'll give painting a go or find another calming hobby.

session_10.speaker: Ethan
session_10.text: Hey Seth, painting is super chill for calming down. Wanna give it a try? I can help you get started and recommend some supplies if you're interested. Let me know!

session_10.speaker: Seth
session_10.text: Sounds great, Ethan! I want to give it a go and see if it relaxes me. Can you suggest some basic supplies for me to get started?

session_10.speaker: Ethan
session_10.text: Yep, painting is awesome! Get some acrylic paints, brushes, a canvas/paper, and a palette to mix colors. I can give you some recommendations if you want. Just let me know when you're ready and we can plan a painting session!

session_10.speaker: Seth
session_10.text: Sounds great, Ethan! Can you help me pick out the stuff? Let's plan a painting session soon. I'm really excited!

session_10.speaker: Ethan
session_10.text: Yeah, Seth - let's do it! Let's get everything ready and paint next Saturday. Can't wait!

session_10.speaker: Seth
session_10.text: Sounds good, Ethan! Can't wait to paint with you next Saturday. It'll be a fun and creative activity.

session_11.speaker: Seth
session_11.text: Hey Ethan, long time no see! I've started eating healthier - what's new with you? Picked up any new hobbies?

session_11.speaker: Ethan
session_11.text: Hey Seth! That's awesome about your healthier eating! For me, I had a setback last week - messed up my knee playing b-ball with the kids. It's been tough to stay active since. I really miss going on adventures like we did last year - good times with the family!

session_11.speaker: Seth
session_11.text: Hey Ethan, sorry to hear about your knee. It must be tough. Are there any ways to stay active while you heal up?

session_11.speaker: Ethan
session_11.text: Thanks, Seth. PT has helped some. I can't do intense workouts, but I'm doing easy exercises to keep it strong. Not as good as being active outdoors, but still something.

session_11.speaker: Seth
session_11.text: Glad PT is helping, Ethan! Taking care of yourself is key – have you explored any fun indoor activities or hobbies?

session_11.speaker: Ethan
session_11.text: I do my favorite watercolor painting to keep me busy. It's a chill way to relax and get into the colors. By the way, something happened two weeks ago! You're not gonna believe this, I had a bit of an adventure recently. Helped a lost tourist find their way, and we ended up taking an unexpected tour around the city. It was a blast!

session_11.speaker: Seth
session_11.text: Hey Ethan, that sounds like a fun and unexpected event! It's always interesting how helping someone can turn into a little adventure of its own. And how's your watercolor painting going?

session_11.speaker: Ethan
session_11.text: It's been great! I find painting to be a great stress reliever. Here's what I did last week.

session_11.speaker: Seth
session_11.text: Wow, those are awesome! So cool. Where did you get the inspiration for them?

session_11.speaker: Ethan
session_11.text: Thanks, Seth! The sunset painting was inspired by a vacation a few years back. The colors were so stunning. The cactus painting came from a road trip last month. Such cool places!

session_11.speaker: Seth
session_11.text: Wow, Ethan, your paintings are awesome! How do you decide what to paint?

session_11.speaker: Ethan
session_11.text: Thanks, Seth! I usually paint what's on my mind or something I'm feeling. It can be good memories or places I wanna go to. It's more like expressing myself through art.

session_11.speaker: Seth
session_11.text: That's really amazing, Ethan. Expressing yourself through art is such a powerful form of self-expression.

session_11.speaker: Ethan
session_11.text: Thanks, Seth. Yeah, it's really a great way to express myself and my emotions. It's a cool way to communicate without using words. So, do you have any other ways in which you express yourself?

session_11.speaker: Seth
session_11.text: Drawing is cool. I'm still just learning how to draw, but I love expressing myself through writing. It's therapeutic and helps me sort out my feelings. Though, I've been a bit frustrated lately with my new phone. Its navigation app keeps malfunctioning, making getting around a bit of a challenge.

session_11.speaker: Ethan
session_11.text: Cool, Seth! Writing is a great way to express yourself. What kind of writing do you enjoy? And about the phone, I recommend trying to update it, it usually works for me!

session_11.speaker: Seth
session_11.text: Thanks for the tip, Ethan! Writing in my journal and doing creative writing is a good way for me to express my innermost thoughts and feelings.

session_11.speaker: Ethan
session_11.text: It can be super therapeutic. It gives you a place to express yourself. Keep it up!

session_11.speaker: Seth
session_11.text: Thanks, Ethan! It really helps me make sense of things and express my feelings. It's like having a conversation with myself.

session_11.speaker: Ethan
session_11.text: Gotcha, it's like having a place to figure stuff out and make sense of it all. We all need an outlet to express our thoughts and feelings.

session_12.speaker: Seth
session_12.text: Hey Ethan, hope you're doing okay. I wanted to chat about something that's been bothering me lately... I went for a check-up Monday and my doc said my weight's a serious health risk - if I don't make changes soon, it can get worse. I know I made jokes about it, but it's really hitting me. Been having a hard time.

session_12.speaker: Ethan
session_12.text: Hey Seth, tough news. Yeah, our health can really put a damper on things. I started lifting weights one year ago and it's been a journey. It was a struggle at first, but I'm seeing some gains. You interested in trying it out?

session_12.speaker: Seth
session_12.text: Hey Ethan, I'm interested in getting into it. Any advice on how to get started? Thanks!

session_12.speaker: Ethan
session_12.text: Hey Seth, that's awesome! It's important to start out with good form and technique. Find a trainer who can help you avoid injuries while you build your strength. Start with something small, and as you get stronger, the intensity can increase. Stay consistent with your workout routine and let me know how it goes! Good luck!

session_12.speaker: Seth
session_12.text: Thanks, Ethan. I'm going to find someone who can help me out. I'll keep you posted!

session_12.speaker: Ethan
session_12.text: No problem, Seth. Can't wait to hear about your progress. Keep up the hard work!

session_12.speaker: Seth
session_12.text: Thanks, Ethan. I appreciate your support. It really means a lot to me. I'll definitely keep you posted on my progress.

session_12.speaker: Ethan
session_12.text: You're welcome, Seth! It takes time, so be patient with yourself. Your health matters, and I believe in you. Keep going and stay upbeat. You got this!

session_12.speaker: Seth
session_12.text: Thanks, Ethan. I'll stay positive and keep going. Your support means a lot.

session_12.speaker: Ethan
session_12.text: Hey Seth, glad I can be here for you! Progress is key, so keep pushing on and stay positive. You got this!

session_12.speaker: Seth
session_12.text: Wow, Ethan, that's really inspiring. Gonna keep believing in it!

session_12.speaker: Ethan
session_12.text: Go get 'em! Believe in your abilities and you'll reach your goals. Stay motivated!

session_12.speaker: Seth
session_12.text: Thanks Ethan! Your words gave me a boost. I'm staying motivated and believing in myself.

session_12.speaker: Ethan
session_12.text: Awesome! Keep staying motivated and believing in yourself. You've got this!

session_12.speaker: Seth
session_12.text: Thanks, Ethan! Your support means a lot to me.

session_12.speaker: Ethan
session_12.text: No prob, Seth! I'm here for you. Just keep taking one step at a time, and you'll get there eventually!

session_12.speaker: Seth
session_12.text: Sure, Ethan. I'll take it slow. See ya!

session_13.speaker: Ethan
session_13.text: Hey Seth, how's it going? Been a while since we talked. Hope all is good.

session_13.speaker: Seth
session_13.text: Hey Ethan! It's been a rough week - I gave in and bought some unhealthy snacks. I feel kinda guilty. How's it going for you? That painting is awesome! Did you paint it?

session_13.speaker: Ethan
session_13.text: Hey Seth, sorry to hear about the rough week. Don't worry about the snacks. I'm doing okay, just finished this painting of a sunset. It really helps me relax. So, how's everything going with you? Anything new and exciting?

session_13.speaker: Seth
session_13.text: Thanks, Ethan! Yeah, I just couldn't resist them. Gotta do better. As for me, just dealing with work stress and trying to stay motivated.

session_13.speaker: Ethan
session_13.text: Hey Seth, work stress can really get to you. Have you tried anything new to de-stress? Maybe picking up a hobby or something could help.

session_13.speaker: Seth
session_13.text: Thinking about trying something different outdoors. Any suggestions?

session_13.speaker: Ethan
session_13.text: Sounds good! Have you ever tried kayaking? It's a fun and active way to paddle on a river or lake. What are your thoughts on that?

session_13.speaker: Seth
session_13.text: Kayaking sounds awesome! Haven't tried it yet, but it looks like a fun way to get in some exercise and enjoy nature. I'm definitely considering giving it a try. Thanks!

session_13.speaker: Ethan
session_13.text: No worries, Seth! It's a fun way to get in some exercise and enjoy nature. Let me know when you're ready to give it a try and I can hook you up with a good spot.

session_13.speaker: Seth
session_13.text: Thanks for the idea, my mate and I are just around the corner from kayaking on the lake, we're going to try that now!

session_13.speaker: Ethan
session_13.text: Of course, let me know if you like it, we can plan a kayaking trip together, I'll pick a cool spot!

session_13.speaker: Seth
session_13.text: Yep, Ethan! Can't wait. Thanks for the help!

session_13.speaker: Ethan
session_13.text: Ready for an adventure? Where will you go?

session_13.speaker: Seth
session_13.text: We're traveling through Lake Tahoe! I heard it's great for kayaking.

session_13.speaker: Ethan
session_13.text: Hey Seth, it's an awesome pick! You'll love it there - clear water and gorgeous views. Have a blast and take lots of pics!

session_13.speaker: Seth
session_13.text: Thanks, Ethan! I'm looking forward to it!

session_14.speaker: Seth
session_14.text: Hey Ethan! I've been missing our chats. I had quite the health scare last weekend - ended up in the ER with a severe stomachache. Turns out, it was gastritis, which was pretty alarming. It was a wake-up call for me to start prioritizing my health, like adopting a more nutritious diet and getting regular exercise. On top of that, my phone's been giving me a hard time, adding to the stress.

session_14.speaker: Ethan
session_14.text: Hey Seth, sorry to hear about that. Gastritis can be tough. Taking care of ourselves is important. BTW, I've been focusing on fitness and it's been really beneficial for my overall well-being. Funny thing, I had another encounter with a lost tourist recently. Seems like helping tourists is becoming a recurring theme in my life!

session_14.speaker: Seth
session_14.text: Thanks, Ethan! Glad you've found that it's been good for you! I totally need to get into it too. Just getting started is hard - any tips for staying motivated? Also, you mentioned another lost tourist? Seems like you're becoming the go-to guy for tourists in need!

session_14.speaker: Ethan
session_14.text: Yup, Seth! Set some goals, like a certain distance to run or number of push-ups to do. It'll give you something to strive for and stay motivated. Also, try to find an exercise that you enjoy and maybe even get a buddy for extra fun and accountability. Sound good?

session_14.speaker: Seth
session_14.text: Yeah, that sounds like a good idea. Having goals and someone to exercise with might help. I'll give it a try!

session_14.speaker: Ethan
session_14.text: Awesome, Seth! Getting started will get easier with time. And don't forget it's about feeling good and reaching goals, too. Let's plan a hike soon!

session_14.speaker: Seth
session_14.text: Sounds awesome, Ethan! Can't wait to go on a hike with you. It's going to be a fun challenge and a great opportunity to appreciate the beauty of nature.

session_14.speaker: Ethan
session_14.text: Definitely, Seth! Hiking is an awesome way to bond with nature and push ourselves. It's gonna be a cool memory for us both. It's great to see progress, was just at the gym yesterday. Gaining strength!

session_14.speaker: Seth
session_14.text: Super excited to get fit with ya. Let's hit the trails soon!

session_14.speaker: Ethan
session_14.text: Thanks, Seth! That's so nice of you. We'll definitely have a great time on our hike!

session_14.speaker: Seth
session_14.text: Totally! I'm so pumped for this hike. Connecting with nature is exactly what I need. Thanks so much for the support and always being there. Means a lot.

session_14.speaker: Ethan
session_14.text: Sure thing! Our hike is going to be awesome, I can tell. I'm always here to support you.

session_14.speaker: Seth
session_14.text: Thanks, Ethan. I appreciate your support.

session_14.speaker: Ethan
session_14.text: No problem, Seth. Whenever you need support, I'm here for you. Stay safe!

session_14.speaker: Seth
session_14.text: Thanks, I'll get in touch if I need anything. Stay safe. Bye!

session_14.speaker: Ethan
session_14.text: Later! Stay safe and don't hesitate to holler if you need anything. Can't wait to hit the trail.

session_15.speaker: Seth
session_15.text: Morning, Ethan. I've been trying to keep up with my new health routine, but it's tough. My family's really pushing for it, and I feel so pressured.

session_15.speaker: Ethan
session_15.text: I hear you, Seth. It's important to have people who encourage you, but not stress you out. By the way, I just got back from my morning walk. It really helps to start the day actively.

session_15.speaker: Seth
session_15.text: Yeah, it's easier when you have a great support system. Thanks for being there for me.

session_15.speaker: Ethan
session_15.text: No worries, Seth. I'll be there for you. Take it slow and treat yourself.

session_15.speaker: Seth
session_15.text: Thanks for the reminder to take it easy. I sometimes get impatient with myself when I want results fast, but I gotta be patient.

session_15.speaker: Ethan
session_15.text: Yep, progress takes time. So just take it one step at a time.

session_15.speaker: Seth
session_15.text: Yes, you're right, Ethan. Taking it slow is better than doing too much. I appreciate your support.

session_15.speaker: Ethan
session_15.text: I get it, Seth. I went through a similar phase a twoyears ago. Changed my diet, started walking regularly, things like that.

session_15.speaker: Seth
session_15.text: Wow, Ethan, you look great! How did you manage the change?

session_15.speaker: Ethan
session_15.text: I started focusing more on my well-being rather than fixating on quick results. Letting go of that pressure made a huge difference.

session_15.speaker: Seth
session_15.text: That's impressive, Ethan. It's inspiring to see how you transformed by changing your mindset.

session_15.speaker: Ethan
session_15.text: Thanks, Seth. Letting go of unrealistic expectations was liberating, both physically and mentally.

session_15.speaker: Seth
session_15.text: You're really doing great, Ethan! I want to feel that same sense of freedom.

session_15.speaker: Ethan
session_15.text: Thanks, Seth. Just take it one day at a time. Celebrate small victories.

session_15.speaker: Seth
session_15.text: Thanks, Ethan! Focusing on small wins sounds like a plan. I'll take it one day at a time.

session_15.speaker: Ethan
session_15.text: Exactly! Congrats on every little victory. Keep it up, I'm here for you.

session_15.speaker: Seth
session_15.text: Your support means everything. Here's to moving forward!

session_15.speaker: Ethan
session_15.text: Anytime, Seth! Let's keep pushing ahead. I'm here to help you. Take care!

session_16.speaker: Seth
session_16.text: Hey Ethan! Hope you're doing good. Got some good news to share - I'm a Weight Watchers coach in my group now! It's a pretty big accomplishment for me, feel really proud.

session_16.speaker: Ethan
session_16.text: Congrats Seth! That's awesome! I'm super proud of you. Becoming a Weight Watchers coach is a big deal. Keep going!

session_16.speaker: Seth
session_16.text: Thanks, Ethan! Appreciate your support. It's been a journey, and being chosen as a coach is a great step in my quest for better health.

session_16.speaker: Ethan
session_16.text: Wow, Seth! You've come such a long way. It's exciting to see what comes next for you in your quest for better health.

session_16.speaker: Seth
session_16.text: Thanks, Ethan! It feels great to see progress. Being a coach will hopefully keep me motivated and help others stay committed too. It's a big challenge, but I'm ready for it!

session_16.speaker: Ethan
session_16.text: That's awesome, Seth! Helping others stay committed and motivated is so rewarding. You really inspire us. Keep up the great work!

session_16.speaker: Seth
session_16.text: Thanks, Ethan! Your kind words mean a lot. It's been a difficult road, but I'm determined to continue making a positive impact.

session_16.speaker: Ethan
session_16.text: Sorry about missing any events, I've had some personal challenges since we last spoke. Still here for you though - do you need any support or want to share anything? Btw look what i got!

session_16.speaker: Seth
session_16.text: Hey, it looks so vintage and cool! What model is it? How've you been doing lately? I'm here if you wanna chat.

session_16.speaker: Ethan
session_16.text: It's a 1968 Kustom K-200A vintage guitar and I got it as a gift from a close friend. It's been a tough time for me since we last caught up; I lost my job last month, which has been pretty rough. But I really appreciate your support through all this.

session_16.speaker: Seth
session_16.text: Sorry to hear about your job, Ethan. What happened?

session_16.speaker: Ethan
session_16.text: It's been a bit of a rough patch lately. The company downsized, and I was part of that. I'm currently on the hunt for a new job, which hasn't been easy, but I'm keeping my spirits up and staying hopeful.

session_16.speaker: Seth
session_16.text: Sorry about your job, Ethan. It's tough when it comes out of nowhere, but I'm proud of how you're handling it. Let me know if you need someone to talk to or if I can do anything to help. You'll get through this.

session_16.speaker: Ethan
session_16.text: Thanks, Seth. Your support means a lot. It's been quite a ride, but I really appreciate having someone like you to talk to. I'll definitely reach out if I need anything.

session_16.speaker: Seth
session_16.text: For sure, Ethan! I'm here for ya. Life can be tough sometimes, but we got this. Stay positive and it'll all work out. Just know that I'm here if you need someone to talk to.

session_16.speaker: Ethan
session_16.text: Thanks, Seth. Your kind words and support mean a lot. It's great to have you here. I'm gonna stay positive and keep going. Cheers!

session_16.speaker: Seth
session_16.text: Wow, that sunset is stunning! It's so soothing just to see it. Is that a special spot you go to watch sunsets?

session_16.speaker: Ethan
session_16.text: Yeah, it's this peaceful place close to my home. I often go there to relax and unwind.

session_16.speaker: Seth
session_16.text: That sounds wonderful, Ethan! I'd love to check it out with you sometime.

session_16.speaker: Ethan
session_16.text: Oh, I wish I could bring you along. That picture was actually taken last Friday at my favorite spot by the beach. Watching the waves and the sunset colors really helps me find peace, especially during tough times. It's a beautiful reminder of nature's resilience. We should definitely plan to go together someday.

session_16.speaker: Seth
session_16.text: No worries, Ethan. And yes, we should make a plan to go. That photo is just mesmerizing!

session_16.speaker: Ethan
session_16.text: I'm glad you like it! It's a really calming place. Let's make a point to visit it together soon.

session_16.speaker: Seth
session_16.text: Absolutely, Ethan! A trip there sounds like the perfect way to de-stress.

session_16.speaker: Ethan
session_16.text: Awesome, let's do it! Let's plan it for next month, I'm already excited about exploring it together!

session_17.speaker: Seth
session_17.text: Hey Ev! Long time no chat. How's it going? Hope all is well.

session_17.speaker: Ethan
session_17.text: Hey Seth, good to hear from you! Life's been a wild ride lately. Last week, I had a health scare and had to go to the hospital. They found something suspicious during a check-up, which freaked me out. Thankfully, it was all a misunderstanding, but it made me realize how important it is to keep an eye on my health. How've you been?

session_17.speaker: Seth
session_17.text: Woah, Ethan, that must've been scary! Phew, it was just a misunderstanding. A health scare can really make you re-evaluate what's important. As for me, I've been dealing with some discomfort and it's been limiting my movement. I've been trying to make changes diet-wise, but it can be hard.

session_17.speaker: Ethan
session_17.text: That sucks, Seth. It's tough when our health holds us back. I believe in you – just taking small steps can help. Have you tried any new hobbies recently to take your mind off it?

session_17.speaker: Seth
session_17.text: Thanks, Ethan. I haven't tried much new lately, but I did get this yesterday. It's been my go-to 'feel good' flick. So, you said you had a health scare - how're you now?

session_17.speaker: Ethan
session_17.text: That movie sounds interesting! I'm doing well now. Doctors said everything is fine, but it taught me the value of life. Just trying to enjoy the moment.

session_17.speaker: Seth
session_17.text: That's awesome, Ethan! Let's make it a habit to appreciate something each day. It really helps us enjoy life more. What do you think?

session_17.speaker: Ethan
session_17.text: Sounds good, Seth! Let's take the time to appreciate the little things in life.

session_17.speaker: Seth
session_17.text: Thanks for always being there, Ethan. It means a lot.

session_17.speaker: Ethan
session_17.text: Sure, Seth. I'm here for you. We gotta stick together, especially now.

session_17.speaker: Seth
session_17.text: Yeah, Ethan. Life can be tough sometimes, but having supportive people like you makes it way easier.

session_17.speaker: Ethan
session_17.text: Yeah, Seth. Tough times are way easier with friends we can rely on. We've got each other!

session_17.speaker: Seth
session_17.text: Looks like you're having a blast! I was wondering, what do you do to stay fit and healthy?

session_17.speaker: Ethan
session_17.text: That was wild! I stay in shape by hitting the gym and taking my car out for a spin. Gotta keep it up! How are you doing on your fitness goals, Seth?

session_17.speaker: Seth
session_17.text: Fitness goals have been hard to reach, but hey, that's life!

session_17.speaker: Ethan
session_17.text: Yeah Seth, it's true. Progress takes time, so keep pushing.

session_17.speaker: Seth
session_17.text: Where is that? It looks gorgeous!

session_17.speaker: Ethan
session_17.text: This little island is where I grew up and it's my happy place.

session_17.speaker: Seth
session_17.text: Wow, that spot looks gorgeous. Growing up there must have been so peaceful and stunning.

session_17.speaker: Ethan
session_17.text: Yeah, it was. That place shaped me and will always hold a special place in my heart.

session_17.speaker: Seth
session_17.text: Yeah, it can be soul-calming.

session_17.speaker: Ethan
session_17.text: Yeah, it really is. So serene and calming.

session_17.speaker: Seth
session_17.text: It's heavenly!

session_17.speaker: Ethan
session_17.text: Yeah, it's like a little slice of paradise. I always feel so peaceful and serene when I'm there.

session_17.speaker: Seth
session_17.text: Wow, it really seems like a peaceful retreat. Thanks for showing me!

session_17.speaker: Ethan
session_17.text: No prob, always good to chat about those tranquil times. Take it easy!

session_17.speaker: Seth
session_17.text: Take care, buddy. Hang in there!

session_17.speaker: Ethan
session_17.text: Thanks, Seth. If you need to talk, I'm here for you too.

session_18.speaker: Ethan
session_18.text: Hey Seth, good to hear from you. I've hit a bit of a snag - my new Prius, the one I just bought, broke down. It's a bit of a stressor since I rely on it for my active lifestyle and road trips. It's frustrating when new things go awry so soon.

session_18.speaker: Seth
session_18.text: Hey Ethan, that's rough. Dealing with a new car breaking down is such a hassle, especially when it's your main mode of transport.

session_18.speaker: Ethan
session_18.text: You're telling me. I was really counting on this new Prius to be reliable. It's always a challenge when you have to deal with unexpected issues like this. But, I guess it's just one of those things - even new cars can have problems.

session_18.speaker: Seth
session_18.text: It's tough when your plans get derailed by something like this. But hey, sometimes these setbacks lead to new opportunities.

session_18.speaker: Ethan
session_18.text: True, I'm trying to see it as a chance to explore other ways of staying active and traveling. Maybe it's an opportunity to try something different.

session_18.speaker: Seth
session_18.text: Exactly, it's all about finding the silver lining. Speaking of new things, I attended a Weight Watchers meeting yesterday. Learned some great tips.

session_18.speaker: Ethan
session_18.text: That smoothie bowl looks fantastic! How was the meeting? Yeah, I've been thinking about trying yoga, something gentle yet effective for stress relief and flexibility. What's your take on it, Seth?

session_18.speaker: Seth
session_18.text: The meeting was really insightful, and that smoothie bowl was a hit! Yoga's a great choice, it's done wonders for my flexibility and stress levels. You should definitely try it.

session_18.speaker: Ethan
session_18.text: I think I will. Thanks for the suggestion, Seth.

session_18.speaker: Seth
session_18.text: Anytime, Ethan. If you need any yoga tips or anything else, just let me know.

session_18.speaker: Ethan
session_18.text: Your support's been invaluable. Thanks again, Seth!

session_18.speaker: Seth
session_18.text: No worries, Ethan. We all need a bit of help when trying new things. It's great to have support.

session_18.speaker: Ethan
session_18.text: Absolutely. It makes a big difference knowing you're not alone in these situations.

session_18.speaker: Seth
session_18.text: Definitely. Take care, and let me know how the yoga goes. Bye!

session_18.speaker: Ethan
session_18.text: Will do. Thanks for everything, Seth. Talk soon. Bye!

session_19.speaker: Ethan
session_19.text: Hey Seth, hope you're doing good. Wanted to share some amazing news - my partner is pregnant! We're so excited! It's been a while since we had a kiddo around.

session_19.speaker: Seth
session_19.text: Congrats, Ev! That's great news! Parenthood is so amazing. How are you feeling about it?

session_19.speaker: Ethan
session_19.text: So excited and a bit nervous! It's been a while since I had a toddler around but I'm really looking forward to it. Parenthood is so rewarding. I still remember when my first child was born, the joy was amazing. Looking forward to witness the miracle of life and build more memories with my family!

session_19.speaker: Seth
session_19.text: Wow, you're gonna be an amazing parent! Treasure those memories, they're truly special.

session_19.speaker: Ethan
session_19.text: Thanks Seth! Absolutely. Talking of memories, I want to show you this. It's a collage of some of our top family memories. Each photo has an amazing moment - birthdays, holidays, vacations - so good to look back and recall all the great times we had.

session_19.speaker: Seth
session_19.text: That's so lovely, Ethan. Your family looks so happy. What's the story behind that sign in the center?

session_19.speaker: Ethan
session_19.text: Oh, that one? It's from our trip to Banff. We have this sign in the frame that says 'Bring it on Home' - it's our family's motto, always reminding us of the importance of togetherness, no matter where we are.

session_19.speaker: Seth
session_19.text: That's really touching, Ethan. It's important to have something that keeps the family bond strong.

session_19.speaker: Ethan
session_19.text: Absolutely, Seth. My family means the world to me. They're my rock. I'm looking forward to expanding our family and creating even more beautiful memories.

session_19.speaker: Seth
session_19.text: That's wonderful to hear, Ethan! It's clear how much you value your family. Are you thinking of any specific plans or events to add to that collage?

session_19.speaker: Ethan
session_19.text: Thanks, Seth! Yeah, we're planning a big family reunion next summer. It's going to be a blast and a perfect opportunity to add to our collage.

session_19.speaker: Seth
session_19.text: Sounds fantastic! If you need any tips on organizing such a big event, just let me know. I'm always here to support and celebrate your family's milestones.

session_19.speaker: Ethan
session_19.text: Thanks, Seth! Your support means a lot. I'll keep you updated. Take care, bye!

session_19.speaker: Seth
session_19.text: Take care, Ethan! Can't wait to hear about it. Bye!

session_19.speaker: Ethan
session_19.text: Bye Seth. I'll definitely keep you updated. Thanks for the kind words and support. Take care!

session_20.speaker: Ethan
session_20.text: Hey Seth, what's up? Long time no see, huh? Lots has happened.

session_20.speaker: Seth
session_20.text: Hey Ethan! Long time no see. I'm doing okay, been through a few bumps. How about you?

session_20.speaker: Ethan
session_20.text: It's not easy for us right now, my son had an accident last Tuesday, he fell off his bike and it was rough. But he's doing better now. How are you dealing with all this?

session_20.speaker: Seth
session_20.text: Darn, sorry to hear that. Hope he's feeling better. Same here, it's been tough lately. After we talked, I started thinking about ways to cope with it, but it's been challenging.

session_20.speaker: Ethan
session_20.text: Life can be hard sometimes. Do you have any hobbies or activities that make you happy?

session_20.speaker: Seth
session_20.text: I used to love hiking, but it's been a while since I had the chance to do it.

session_20.speaker: Ethan
session_20.text: I remember you mentioning that! Hiking is indeed a great way to center oneself and be one with nature. We should definitely plan a hike soon!

session_20.speaker: Seth
session_20.text: Yeah, I'm struggling with my weight and it's affecting my confidence. I feel like I can't overcome all the challenges with my weight, I keep lacking motivation.

session_20.speaker: Ethan
session_20.text: Yeah, I understand it can be challenging. But remember, it's important to believe in yourself and take it one day at a time, Seth. Your worth is not defined by your weight.

session_20.speaker: Seth
session_20.text: Cheers, Ethan. Appreciate the help. It's tough breaking out of my comfort zone.

session_20.speaker: Ethan
session_20.text: Stepping out of your comfort zone can be intimidating, but it's totally worth it. Just challenge yourself to try something new, even if it's just a little thing. You got this!

session_20.speaker: Seth
session_20.text: Thanks, Ethan. I'll take your advice. Trying new things can be difficult.

session_20.speaker: Ethan
session_20.text: Yeah, trying something new and succeeding gives a great feeling of accomplishment. Give it a go, even if it's just a little thing. You'll be amazed!

session_20.speaker: Seth
session_20.text: She looks so confident! What kind of painting is that in the background?

session_20.speaker: Ethan
session_20.text: This is a contemporary figurative painting that I've finished few days ago, emphasizing the emotional state through expressive brushwork and vibrant color choices. It captures a moment of introspection, where the subject is deeply immersed in thought. Very proud of it!

session_20.speaker: Seth
session_20.text: That's amazing work, who's the girl standing next to painting?

session_20.speaker: Ethan
session_20.text: That's a close friend of mine who helped me get this painting published in the exhibition!

session_21.speaker: Seth
session_21.text: Hey Ethan! Long time no see, how's it going?

session_21.speaker: Ethan
session_21.text: Hey Seth! Long time no see! Been up and down lately, got married last week - how about you?

session_21.speaker: Seth
session_21.text: Congratulations, Ethan! Is that the woman from Canada?

session_21.speaker: Ethan
session_21.text: Yes, that's her, I don't know why we didn't get married before, because I was in love with her at first sight!

session_21.speaker: Seth
session_21.text: Wow, Ethan! Love at first sight? That sounds like something straight out of a fairy tale. What are your thoughts on it? Do you believe in love at first sight?

session_21.speaker: Ethan
session_21.text: I totally believe in it. It was like time stopped and I felt like a spark lit inside me - it was so right.

session_21.speaker: Seth
session_21.text: That's awesome, Ethan! Finding that kind of connection must feel really liberating. Love can be so powerful, huh?

session_21.speaker: Ethan
session_21.text: Yeah, Seth, love is truly amazing. It brings so much happiness and fulfillment, like a beautiful sunset that lights up our lives and brings peace. Incredible!

session_21.speaker: Seth
session_21.text: Wish I could feel the same about love, but I've started to enjoy running in the mornings, and it's been a great way to clear my head. What can you do, right?

session_21.speaker: Ethan
session_21.text: Yeah, I get it. Life's all about finding what works for you. Like your morning runs, they're a step towards something good, right? Keep trying new things, Seth, and you might find your own version of love in the most unexpected places. Embrace the journey — it’s full of surprises!

session_21.speaker: Seth
session_21.text: Such a minimalistic and stunning piece of work, I wonder what inspired the artist to create it.

session_21.speaker: Ethan
session_21.text: The painting is mine, I made it when I was a mix of emotions - sad, mad, and hopeful. Art is amazing how it can portray feelings without words.

session_21.speaker: Seth
session_21.text: Wow, Ethan! Art is really amazing at expressing emotions - it's truly fascinating.

session_21.speaker: Ethan
session_21.text: It's amazing how art can express emotions so well. It really helps me recognize and handle my own feelings. This painting is giving me a massive rush of joy!

session_21.speaker: Seth
session_21.text: That's stunning! What emotions did you create this painting with?

session_21.speaker: Ethan
session_21.text: I painted this with a sense of joy and freedom. The spontaneous strokes and bold colors reflect a playful and liberated mood, embracing the creative process without restraint.

session_21.speaker: Seth
session_21.text: Wow, Ethan, this is amazing! You've got serious talent and creativity. Making this must have been so satisfying! Here's a painting that inspired me when I went to an exhibit few days ago.

session_21.speaker: Ethan
session_21.text: Thanks, Seth! I appreciate the compliment. This painting has such an inspiring vibe; you really have a knack for understanding art! How about you? How long have you been painting?

session_21.speaker: Seth
session_21.text: I do sketch occasionally, but I haven't created anything remarkable yet. I have a feeling I'll have something to show off before long! Seeing your passion for it is inspiring.

session_21.speaker: Ethan
session_21.text: Thanks, Seth! Glad I could motivate you. If you ever want to give it a go, I'm happy to help get you started. Speaking of which, you know what? I lost my keys again, it's become a weekly ritual for me!

session_21.speaker: Seth
session_21.text: Ooh, Ethan, I'd put a GPS sensor on your keys!

session_21.speaker: Ethan
session_21.text: Great idea, I think I'll do that as soon as I find it!

session_22.speaker: Seth
session_22.text: Hey Ethan! I’m really getting into this healthier lifestyle—just took my friends on an epic hiking trip last Friday!

session_22.speaker: Ethan
session_22.text: Hey Seth! That’s fantastic—nothing like a good hike to feel alive. We took the Prius for a long drive to the mountains last weekend. It was perfect until we got into a little scrape on the way back.

session_22.speaker: Seth
session_22.text: Oh no, were you guys okay after the accident?

session_22.speaker: Ethan
session_22.text: Yeah, we were fine, thanks. Just a minor accident, but it put a bit of a damper on telling my work friends about getting married. They’ve been a great support, though.

session_22.speaker: Seth
session_22.text: I bet they were thrilled to hear about your marriage, despite the mishap!

session_22.speaker: Ethan
session_22.text: Absolutely, it's been a whirlwind of emotions. Good thing the accident was minor. Just a reminder to take it easy on the road, I guess.

session_22.speaker: Seth
session_22.text: True, it’s important to stay safe. Glad you can still enjoy the peaceful moments after something like that.

session_22.speaker: Ethan
session_22.text: Definitely, nature brings peace and clarity - it's a great experience.

session_22.speaker: Seth
session_22.text: Nature can make everything else seem small and help us find peace inside. It reminds us of the bigger picture, you know?

session_22.speaker: Ethan
session_22.text: For sure, and nature has been a great healer. Speaking of which, I’ve got to share some of these new healthy snacks I’ve been trying.

session_22.speaker: Seth
session_22.text: They look healthy and delicious! Perfect for after a hike or, I guess, post-accident recovery, huh?

session_22.speaker: Ethan
session_22.text: Exactly! They’re packed with nutrients and really easy to make. You also need to try these cookies, they are awesome! I’ll send you the recipes.

session_22.speaker: Seth
session_22.text: Thanks, I’d appreciate that. It’s good to find new ways to stay healthy. Do you have any healthier snack ideas?

session_22.speaker: Ethan
session_22.text: Yeah, I've been trying to eat healthier too. Check out this cool recipe I discovered for these energy balls.

session_22.speaker: Seth
session_22.text: Do you like them? I know they can be an acquired taste.

session_22.speaker: Ethan
session_22.text: I enjoy the taste of these. They're energizing and a healthy way to satisfy your sweet tooth.

session_22.speaker: Seth
session_22.text: Awesome! Always on the lookout for healthy snacks, thanks for the tip!

session_22.speaker: Ethan
session_22.text: Glad to help - hope you enjoy it!

session_22.speaker: Seth
session_22.text: Thanks, Ethan! I'll give these a try. They look yum. Your help means a lot to me. Btw you know what? I went to the store again and, unsurprisingly, had issues with the self-checkout. It's becoming a regular annoyance.

session_22.speaker: Ethan
session_22.text: That's very strange, I've never had a problem with it once!

session_22.speaker: Seth
session_22.text: Apparently I attract that to me, if you ever want to be in that situation, call me at the store with you!

session_23.speaker: Ethan
session_23.text: Hey Seth, guess what? My partner and I told our extended fam about our marriage yesterday – it was so special! We've been totally overwhelmed by all their love and support.

session_23.speaker: Seth
session_23.text: Congrats on the news, Ethan! You two look so happy in the pic. These moments make life so wonderful; super stoked for you!

session_23.speaker: Ethan
session_23.text: Thanks, Seth! It was an awesome moment, and I feel really lucky to have found someone who gets me. Plus, our families are really happy for us - that's the best part!

session_23.speaker: Seth
session_23.text: Wow, Ethan. It's awesome that you've found someone who gets you! Having your family's support must feel great.

session_23.speaker: Ethan
session_23.text: Definitely, family support is so important. Knowing they're happy about our marriage is awesome and so comforting.

session_23.speaker: Seth
session_23.text: Yeah, it's awesome to have that support. It definitely brings more happiness and joy.

session_23.speaker: Ethan
session_23.text: Yeah Seth, that means a lot to me. Our bond just keeps getting stronger and it brings such a good feeling to our lives. Family really is everything.

session_23.speaker: Seth
session_23.text: Agree, Ethan! Family is everything - they bring so much love and happiness. They're always there for us no matter what. I'm grateful for their support and love.

session_23.speaker: Ethan
session_23.text: For sure, Seth. That's what makes family so special. They bring so much love and happiness. It's great having their support and knowing they're always there for us. I feel really fortunate to have their never-ending love and support.

session_23.text: Yeah, definitely, Ethan. We both have amazing families that are always there for us. Always a blessing.

session_23.speaker: Ethan
session_23.text: Yeah, Seth. Our families give us so much joy, support, and love. They're a real blessing! I don't know what I'd do without them.

session_23.speaker: Seth
session_23.text: Hey, Ethan. My family has been my rock through everything. Don't know what I'd do without them.

session_23.speaker: Ethan
session_23.text: Yeah, they are our rock. We're blessed to have them.

session_23.text: Wow, you guys are awesome! What's cooking tonight?

session_23.speaker: Seth

session_23.speaker: Seth
session_23.text: Ooh, nice cake! Reminds me of special occasions. Do you have any upcoming plans?

session_23.speaker: Ethan
session_23.text: Thanks Seth! We're off to Canada next month for our honeymoon. So excited to create some awesome memories. Looking forward to exploring the beautiful snowy landscapes there.

session_23.speaker: Seth
session_23.text: Wow, that looks great! What are your plans for the trip?

session_23.speaker: Ethan
session_23.text: We're planning to ski, try the local cuisine, and enjoy the beautiful views. We're really excited!

session_23.speaker: Seth
session_23.text: Sounds amazing, Ev! Skiing, trying local dishes, and enjoying the breathtaking views - the perfect honeymoon. Have an incredible time creating unforgettable memories!

session_23.text: Yeah, Seth! Gonna try some poutine while we're there - can't wait!

session_23.speaker: Ethan
session_23.text: Cool, Seth. I'll keep you posted. Talk soon!

session_23.speaker: Ethan
session_23.text: Thanks, Seth! Catch you later. Have a great one!

session_24.speaker: Ethan
session_24.text: Hey Seth, hope you're doing good. Something funny happened last night.

session_24.speaker: Seth
session_24.text: Hey Ethan, what's up? What happened? Let me know.

session_24.speaker: Ethan
session_24.text: Yesterday I went out with my friends and had a bit too much to drink. I ended up doing something I regret and it involved someone's roses.

session_24.speaker: Seth
session_24.text: What's up with that incident? All good now?

session_24.speaker: Ethan
session_24.text: Oof, Seth, so embarrassing! I had a pee accident near some roses - can you believe it? I'm so sorry about that.

session_24.speaker: Seth
session_24.text: Uh oh, Ethan! That's awkward. Did anyone get mad at you? Are you okay?

session_24.speaker: Ethan
session_24.text: I was so embarrassed when I saw what happened the next morning, so I apologized and luckily they were understanding. Yeah, I was out of control--guess I gotta be more careful next time.

session_24.speaker: Seth
session_24.text: They were understanding? Phew! We all mess up sometimes, we're human after all.

session_24.speaker: Ethan
session_24.text: Yeah, they were understanding, which was great. But it's a good reminder to be more careful. We all make mistakes, but it's important to learn from them. Speaking of, my partner and I tried snowshoeing this weekend. It was part of a new adventure for us and surprisingly fun.

session_24.speaker: Seth
session_24.text: Yeah, Ethan, you're right. Mistakes happen, but it's good to learn from them. Snowshoeing sounds like a great way to stay active during the winter. I've been thinking and I made a meal plan and workout schedule. I'm getting motivated by something I saw, so starting today I'm gonna do my best to stay on track.

session_24.speaker: Ethan
session_24.text: Good work, Seth! You've got a plan and you're dedicated to staying healthy - have you asked your doctor for advice? They could probably give you even more diet and exercise tips.

session_24.speaker: Seth
session_24.text: Thanks, Ethan! Haven't seen a doctor in a while, but it's probably a good idea to get some advice. I'm going to make an appointment soon.

session_24.speaker: Ethan
session_24.text: What advice are you planning to get from the doctor?

session_24.speaker: Seth
session_24.text: I'm gonna ask the doc about a balanced diet plan and getting advice on low-impact exercises, given my current situation.

session_24.speaker: Ethan
session_24.text: Sounds good, Seth. That's definitely a step in the right direction. Remember to focus on a balanced diet and low-impact exercises. Let me know how it goes.

session_24.speaker: Seth
session_24.text: That looks great! Where did you get the idea for this salad? Also, do you have any suggestions for low-impact exercises?

session_24.speaker: Ethan
session_24.text: I got it from a nearby restaurant. As for low-impact exercises, swimming, yoga, and walking are good options.

session_24.speaker: Seth
session_24.text: The salad idea from a restaurant is a smart move, Ethan! And thanks for the exercise tips. Also I watched The Godfather last night, and it motivated me to keep up with my routine. "I'm gonna make him an offer he can't refuse" - now that's motivation!

session_24.speaker: Ethan
session_24.text: Yoga's definitely a great start, Seth. It's helped me with stress and staying flexible, which is perfect alongside the diet. And yes, The Godfather is a legendary thing to watch, can be re-watched many times!

session_24.speaker: Seth
session_24.text: Between a healthier diet and yoga, I’m hoping for some positive changes.

session_24.speaker: Ethan
session_24.text: By the way there are plenty of other low-impact exercises that can be fun. Going on beach sunsets is one of my favorites - good for exercise and totally calming.

session_24.speaker: Seth
session_24.text: That looks zen. Gonna go for some beach walks - thanks for the tip, Ethan! I want to brag, I had that recurring dream again where I'm flying over skyscrapers!

session_24.speaker: Ethan
session_24.text: I think a little more and you'll learn how to control those dreams, once you get the hang of it let me know haha! Enjoy the fresh air and the views. Have fun!

session_24.speaker: Seth
session_24.text: Thanks Ethan! Gonna make the most of it. You too, have a good one!

session_25.speaker: Seth
session_25.text: Hey Ethan, been a few days since we last chatted. Hope you're doing OK. A lot's happened since then. Got issues with my health, it's been rough. Feels like this weight's keeping me from fully living. Trying to stay positive, not easy.

session_25.speaker: Ethan
session_25.text: Hey Seth, sorry to hear about your health. It's tough when it gets in the way of life. You're being positive, but remember to take care of yourself too. By the way, I had to apologize to my partner for that drunken night, it was pretty embarrassing.

session_25.speaker: Seth
session_25.text: Hey Ethan, that does sound like a tough situation. I'm doing my best with my health. How did your partner take the news about the rose bushes?

session_25.speaker: Ethan
session_25.text: Well, she wasn't thrilled, but understood it was an accident. I promised to be more careful in the future. Changing the subject, have you found any low-impact exercises that you enjoy?

session_25.speaker: Seth
session_25.text: Hey Ethan, haven't found any exercises I like. But lately, I've been on a few car rides. Helps me chill and enjoy the view. Check out this cool pic I snapped last week in the country.

session_25.speaker: Ethan
session_25.text: Nice pic! Does being out in the countryside help you relax and get some fresh air away from the city?

session_25.speaker: Seth
session_25.text: Yeah, being in nature really helps me relax and get some fresh air away from the city.

session_25.speaker: Ethan
session_25.text: Glad to hear it! Nature really has a way of calming and reviving the soul. Last summer, I took this pic on a camping trip - it was such an amazing sunset. Moments like these remind us of the beauty of life, even during tough times.

session_25.speaker: Seth
session_25.text: Wow, that pic is amazing! It must have been a great experience being out on the lake.

session_25.speaker: Ethan
session_25.text: I had a great time kayaking and watching the sunset last summer - it was truly unforgettable. Being out on the water is so peaceful.

session_25.speaker: Seth
session_25.text: Wow, that sounds amazing. Being in nature is so calming, right?

session_25.speaker: Ethan
session_25.text: Nature can be super calming. It's like pushing a reset button for your mind and body.

session_25.speaker: Seth
session_25.text: Definitely, I couldn't agree more. There's something about being outdoors that rejuvenates you. I'm planning to spend more time in nature myself!

session_25.speaker: Ethan
session_25.text: Got it. When health stuff cramps your style, it sucks. But small moments outdoors can make a big impact. This photo reminds me of last spring when I was feeling a bit down, but the vibrant colors brought a smile to my face, even if just for a moment. Remember to find joy in the little things.

session_25.speaker: Seth
session_25.text: That pic is gorgeous! It really brightens my day. Sometimes, it's the little things that matter, right?

session_25.speaker: Ethan
session_25.text: Absolutely, Seth. It's often those little moments that make the biggest difference. Keep finding those bright spots.

session_25.speaker: Seth
session_25.text: Thanks, Ethan. It's good to be reminded to appreciate the small things. They do add up.

session_25.speaker: Ethan
session_25.text: Anytime, Seth. It's all about those small joys, especially when times are tough. You've got this!

session_25.speaker: Seth
session_25.text: Really appreciate it, Ethan. Your words help a lot. Take care!

session_25.speaker: Ethan
session_25.text: You too, Seth. And remember, I'm always here if you need to chat. Look after yourself!
